sa: स पृष्टः पाण्डुपुत्रेण प्रीयमाणो महामनाः। उवाच श्लक्ष्णया वाचा हर्षयन्निव पाण्डवान्॥
en: Having been asked by the son of Pandu, the high-minded (Rishi), being well pleased, spoke in sweet words and delighted the Pandavas.

sa: इमानि चित्राणि च गन्धवन्ति माल्यानि तस्योद्चथितानि पट्टैः। यानि प्रकीर्येह गतः स्वमेव स आश्रमं तपसा द्योतमानः॥
en: These are the beautiful and fragrant garlands entwined with silken threads. They belonged to him. Blazing in ascetic merits he scattered these garlands here and he then went back to his own hermitage.

sa: यद् वै पुरा जातमात्रो रुराव गोमायुवद् विस्वरं पापचेताः दुर्योधनो भरतानां कुलनः सोऽयं युक्तो भरथां कालहेतुः॥
en: When this sinful wretch Duryodhana, this destroyer of the Bharata race, cried like jackal immediately after his, it was well-known that he had been ordained to bring about the destruction of you all.

sa: एवं बहुविधान् देशान् विजित्य पवनात्मजः। वसु तेभ्य उपादाय लौहित्यमगमद् बली॥
en: Having thus conquered various countries and having taken much wealth from them all, the powerful son of Pavana (wind), came to Lohitya.

sa: ततो बाहू समुच्छ्रित्य निवार्य च सभासदः। विदुरः सर्वधर्मज्ञ इदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon Vidura, learned in all the precepts of religion, waving his hands and silencing every one in the assembly, spoke these words.

sa: अवकृष्टस्तु कलिना मोहितः प्राद्रवन्नलः। सुप्तामुत्सृज्य तां भार्यां विलप्य करुणं बहु॥
en: Befooled and deprived of his reason by Kali, Nala ran away deserting his sleeping wife and lainenting profusely and plaintively for her.

sa: व्रतोपवासैर्बहुभिः कृतं भवति भीष्म यत्। सर्वं तदनपत्यस्य मोघं भवति निश्चयात्॥
en: O Bhishma, the merit that is obtained by observing many vows and fasts surely goes all in vain if one is childless.

sa: अनेन विधिना यस्तु पृथिवीं संचरिष्यति। अश्वमेधशतस्याङ्वयं फलं प्रेत्य स भोक्ष्यति॥
en: He who travels over the earth according to these rules obtains the great fruits of one hundred horse-sacrifices and finally obtains salvation.

sa: न चापिधर्ममिच्छामि विलोप्तुं तु कथंचन। एवं तु मे यथाकाम सम्पादयितुमर्हसि॥
en: I never also desire to diminish your virtue in any way. You should therefore do what I desire without injuring your virtue.

sa: अवतीर्य रथात् कृष्णोधर्मराजं यथाविधि। ववन्दे मुदितोधीमान् भीमं च बलिनां वरम्॥
en: Getting down from the car, Krishna following the usual custom, greeted with great delight, the intellectual Dharmaraja and the highly powerful Bhima.

sa: विकर्णेन यथाप्रज्ञःमुक्तः प्रश्नो नराधिपाः। भवन्तोऽपि हि तं प्रश्न विब्रुवन्तु यथामति॥
en: O kings, Vikarna has answered the question according to his knowledge and judgement. You should also answer it as you think proper.

sa: न ते शक्या दरिद्रेण यज्ञाः प्राप्तुं महीपते। बहूपकरणा यज्ञा नानासम्भारविस्तराः॥
en: O ruler of earth, the poor cannot perform these sacrifices, for the sacrifices require many materials and various things in large quantities.

sa: यवक्रीत उवाच नायं शक्यस्त्वया बड़े महानोघस्तपोधन। अशक्याद् विनिवर्तस्व शक्यमर्थं समारभ॥
en: Yavakrit said : O ascetic, you cannot bridge this mighty river. O Brahmana, desist from what is impracticable; attempt some thing practicable.

sa: राज्येन राष्ट्रैश्च निमन्त्र्यमाणाः पित्रा च कृष्णे तव सोदरैश्च। य यज्ञसेनस्य न मातुलाना गृहेषु बाला रतिमाप्नुवन्ति॥
en: And, O Krishna, although your father and your brothers try to tempt them with a kingdom and territories, the boys find no pleasure in the abodes of Yajnasena or of their maternal uncles.

sa: सातत्यं च प्रसङ्गस्य वर्णयेयं यथातथम्॥
en: I would have also described duly the continued desire of playing.

sa: विस्तरेण च मे शंस भीमसेनपराक्रमम्। यद् यच्चक्रे महाबाहुस्तस्मिन् हैमवते गिरौ॥
en: Narrate to me also in detail of the prowess of Bhimasena and what that mighty armed one did in the mountain Himalaya.

sa: वरं ददानि कृष्णायै काक्षितं यद् यदिच्छति॥ अवृणोत् तत्र पाञ्चाली पाण्डवानामदासताम्।
en: "O Krishna, I shall grant you boons whatever you desire to have." Panchali (Draupadi) begged of me the liberation of the Pandavas.

sa: चेतनारहितं काष्ठं यद्यनेन निपातितम्। पादेन शकटं भीष्म तत्र किं कृतमद्भुतम्॥
en: O Bhishma, what is there wonderful if this (Krishna) threw down by a kick an inanimate piece of wood, namely a car?

sa: वामदेव उवाच संस्पृश्यैनां महिषी सायकेन ततस्तस्मादेनसो मोक्ष्यसे त्वम्। ततस्तथा कृतवान् पार्थिवस्तु ततो मुनि राजपुत्री बभाषे॥
en: Vamadeva said: Touching your queen with this arrow, you may cleanse yourself off this sin. After that the king did as he was directed and then the princess spoke thus to the Rishi.

sa: शिशुपाल उवाच विभीषिकाभिर्बह्वीभिर्भीषयन् सर्वपार्थिवान्। न व्यपत्रपसे कस्माद् वृद्धः सन् कुलपांसन॥
en: Shishupala said Old and infamous wretch of your race, are you not ashamed to frighten all these kings by these false terrors?

sa: यद्येष पुरुषो वेद वेदा अपि न तं विदुः। सर्वमाश्चर्यमेवैतन्निर्वृत्तं राजसत्तम॥
en: His knowledge is greater than that of all the celestials. O foremost of kings, of kings, alter dissolution, all this wonderful creation,

sa: इमेऽवहसितुं प्राप्ता द्रौपदी च यशस्विनीम्। ज्ञात्वा चिकीर्षितं चैषां मामुवाच सुरेश्वरः॥
en: They came here to mock you and the illustrious Draupadi. Knowing their purpose the lord of the celestials thus spoke to me,

sa: लोमश उवाच उक्त्वा स पितरं श्लक्ष्णं यवक्रीरकुतोभयः। विप्रकुर्वनृषीनन्यानतुष्यत् परया मुदा॥
en: Lomasha said: Having thus replied to his father in sweet words, Yavakrit began fearlessly to take pleasure in wantonly injuring the Rishis.

sa: क्षितिस्थं सहदेवं च क्षिपन्तं राक्षसं तदा। मार्गाच्च राक्षसं मूढं कालोपहतचेतसम्॥
en: And also Sahadeva who was rebuking the Rakshasa and also that foolish Rakshasa who, being deprived of his (good) sense by Fate,

sa: नास्ति रामस्य सदृशो विक्रमे भुवि कश्चन। विराधो निहतो येन कबन्धश्चान्तकोपमः॥
en: There breathes none on Earth that is like to Rāma in prowess, by whom was slain Virādha and Kabandha, resembling the Destroyer.

sa: स च विग्रहवान् धर्मो राजानं प्रसमीक्षितुम्। तत्राजगाम यत्रासौ कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: The God of Righteousness, in his embodied forin, also came to that place where the Kuru king was for seeing that monarch.

sa: वज्रस्य भर्ता भुवनस्य गोप्ता वृत्रस्य हन्ता नमुचेनिहन्ता। कृष्णे वसानो वसने महात्मा सत्यानृते यो विविनक्ति लोके॥
en: O, the master of thunder, the protector of the universe, the slayer of Vritra and Namuchi, O illustrious one, wearing the black cloth, O Deity, who displays truth and untruth in the universe.

sa: एष चेदिपतिः शूरो धृष्टकेतुर्महारथः। शेते विनिहतः संख्ये हत्वा शत्रून् सहस्रशः॥
en: After having slain thousands of enemies, that brave king of the Chedis, that mighty carwarrior, viz., Dhrishtaketu lies, himself deprived of life.

sa: रसवन्ति च तोयानि शीतान्युष्णानि चैव हि। तस्यां राजर्षयः पुण्यास्तथा ब्रह्मर्षयोऽमलाः॥
en: There are both cold and hot water, they are all sweet and agreeable. There sit holy royal sages and stainless Brahmana Rishis.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच किमाहुर्दैवतं विप्रा राजानं भरतर्षभ। मनुष्याणामधिपतिं तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said 'Why, O foremost of Bharata's race, have the Brahmanas declared that the king, that ruler of men, is a god.

sa: पृश्निरित्युच्यते चान्नं वेद आपोऽमृतं तथा। ममैतानि सदा गर्भः पृश्निगर्भस्ततो ह्यहम्॥
en: The word Prishni includes food, the Vedas, water, and nectar. These four are always in my stomach. Hence am I called Prishnigarbha.

sa: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा तथा चक्रे शचीपतिः। गृथिवीं नास्पृशत् पद्भ्यामनिमेषेक्षणानि च॥ अरजोऽम्बरधारी च नम्लीनकुसुमस्तथा। तं ज्ञात्वा लक्ष्णैः सीता वासवं परिहर्षिता ॥
en: Hearing Sītā's words, the lord of Saçī did accordingly. he did not touch the earth with his feet, and his eyes remained winkless. he bloomed in youth, and the blossoms did not fade on his attire. Thereupon knowing him for Vāsava, Sītā was overjoyed.

sa: पुत्रं तं वारयित्वा तु स्वयमेव व्यवस्थितः। सोऽपि युद्धाद्विनिष्क्रम्य रावणिः समुपाविशत्॥
en: Having desisted his son he himself stood there. And having coming out from the field of action Ravana's son too stood silent.

sa: एवं स्तुतो हृषीकेश उत्तङ्केन महात्मना॥ उत्तङ्कमब्रवीद् विष्णुः प्रीतस्तेऽहं वरं वृणु।
en: There was Hrishikesha (Vishnu) praised by the high-souled Uttanka. Vishnu then thus spoke to Uttanka, “I am gratified, Ask for a boon."

sa: तमुपाध्यायः पीवानमपश्यदुवाच चैनं 'वत्सोपमन्यो केन! वृत्तिं कल्पयसि, पीवानसि दृढम् इति॥
en: His preceptor, seeing him in the best of health, asked, “Upamanyu, my child, by what means you support yourself? You exceedingly plump?"

sa: राजा प्रगल्भं कुरुते मनुष्यं राजा कृशं वै कुरुते मनुष्यम्। राजाभिपन्नस्य कुतः सुखानि राजाभ्युपेतं सुखिनं करोति॥
en: Knowledge makes men proud. The king makes men humble. The man who is assailed by the king can never enjoy happiness. On the other hand, the man who gets royal favours becomes happy.

sa: ततो विक्रममासाद्य धैर्यवान् कपिकुञ्जरः। रावणं वा वधिष्यामि दशग्रीवं महाबलम्। काममस्तु हृता सीता प्रत्याचीर्णं भविष्यति ॥
en: Then summoning energy, that elephantine monkey endued with fortitude reflected, Or I shall slay the Ten-necked Rāvaņa possessed of great strength. Sītā has been carried off; but by this I shall avenge myself.

sa: शक्रचापनिभं चापं विकृष्य कनकाङ्गदम्॥ दीप्तान् त्रिपति नाराचान् सनिव महाविषान् ।
en: And drawing a bow resembling that of Sakra, decked with golden rings, he discharges blazing nāracas, like to serpents of virulent poison.

sa: तमन्वधावन्नृपतिरेक एव युधिष्ठिरः। प्रविशन्तं वनं घोरं लक्ष्यालक्ष्यं क्वचित् क्वचित् ।।
en: King Yudhishthira pursued him alone, as he ran and entered the deep forest, sometimes seen and sometimes not seen by the pursuer.

sa: निर्याणादेव तूर्णं च चलिता हरिवाहिनी। नर्दतां राक्षसेन्द्राणां श्रुत्वा नादं द्रविष्यति॥
en: And as soon as you set out, the monkeyforces, hearing the roars of the foremost Rākșasas-speedily setting themselves in motionshall flee away.

sa: राजन्मन्त्रितपूर्वं नः कुशलैः सह मन्त्रिभिः। विवादश्चापि नो वृत्तः समवेक्ष्य परस्परम्॥
en: O king before this we had deliberated together with wise counsellors, and then we disputed with each other in our respective views.

sa: दिवि देवा महीपाल क्रीडार्थमवनिं गताः। कृत्वा कार्यमिदं चैव ततश्च दिवमागताः॥
en: The deities, O king come to this world for sport. Having achieved their task, they ascended one more to the celestial region.

sa: तदेतत् समनुप्राप्तं पूर्वमेव विशाम्पते। तस्मात् त्वं शृणु तत्त्वेन यथा युद्धमवर्तत॥
en: Now, O monarch, the inevitable consequence of all that has arrived. Listen now from me as to how the battle was fought.

sa: निद्रां चोवाच गच्छ त्वं राक्षसान् सम्प्रमोहय। सा तथोक्ता मघवता देवी परमहर्षिता॥ देवकार्यार्थसिद्धयर्थं प्रामोहयत राक्षसान् ।
en: He then addressed sleep, saying. Go you; and stupefy the Räksasas. Thus accosted by Maghavat, that goddess, exceedingly delighted, for securing success to the work of the celestials, covered the Rākşasas with stupor.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीत् पुनर्दोणः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः। एवमेतद् यथाऽऽत्य त्वं न मिथ्यास्ति कदाचन॥
en: Then did Drona, the foremost among all wielders, of say as a rejoinder: "It is so; what you say is never false.

sa: अभ्यगच्छत् ततो रामः सह तैब्रह्मवादिभिः। कुरुक्षेत्रं महाराज कन्यया सह भारत॥
en: Then did Rama depart accompanied by those utters of Brahma, making for Kurukshetra, O great king, and taking that girl with him.

sa: निर्जित्य मातुलं संख्ये माद्रीपुत्रौ महारथौ। दध्मतुर्मुदितौ शङ्खौ सिंहनादं च नेदतुः॥
en: Obtaining victory in battle, over their uncle, the sons of Madri, greatly delighted blew their conchs and roared out their war cries.

sa: यदि तद्विहतं कार्यं मया प्रज्ञाविपर्ययात्। इहैव प्राणसंन्यासो ममापि ह्यद्य रोचते॥
en: As I have committed such an injury under the influence of my perverse understanding, it behave me to relinquish my life here.

sa: यः स्थितं योजने शैलं गच्छन्पार्श्वेन सेवते। ऊर्ध्वं तथैव कायेन गतः प्राप्नोति योजनम्॥ यस्मात्तु परमं रूपं चतुष्पात्सु न विद्यते। श्रुतः संनादनो नाम वानराणां पितामहः॥ येन युद्धं तदा दत्तं रणे शक्रस्य धीमता। पराजयश्च न प्राप्तः सोऽयं यूथपयूथपः॥
en: He that going touch with his side a mountain situated at the distance of a Yojana, and, rising up, measurə the same length, and whose beauty is surpassed by none among quadrupeds, is known under the name of Sannādana, the grand father of the monkeys; this intelligent one battlºd did he meet with discomfiture. This is that general of the forces. *There is a word, rane, in battle-in this line, left out on the ground of pleonasm.

sa: आकिंचन्यं च राज्यं च तुलया समतोलयम्। अत्यरिच्यत दारियं राज्यादपि गुणाधिकम्॥
en: I weighed poverty and sovereignty in the balance, and found sovereignty wanting, and poverty to all appearances possessed greater merits then sovereignty.

sa: स तं रथं समास्थाय राजा कुरुकुलोद्वहः। अर्ध्वमाचक्रमे शीघ्रं तेजसाऽऽवृत्य रोदसी।॥
en: King Yudhishthira, that perpetuator of Kuru's race, riding on that car, ascended quickly, causing the entire sky to blaze with his effulgence.

sa: शाल्वस्याहमिति प्राह पुरा मामेव भार्गव। मया चैवाभ्यनुज्ञाता गतेयं नगरं प्रति॥
en: To me she said before, I belong to Shalva, you of the Bhrigu race, and permitted by me went towards his capital.

sa: दक्षिणेन सरस्वत्या दृषद्वत्युत्तरेण च। ये वसन्ति कुरुक्षेत्रे ते वसन्ति त्रिविष्टपे॥
en: He who lives in Kurukshetra which is situated south of the Sarasvati and the north of the Drishadvati (really) lives in heaven.

sa: तत् कथं नु महाबाहुर्वासविः परवीरहा। प्रतिज्ञां सफलां कुर्यादिति ते समचिन्तयन्॥
en: How indeed shall the mighty-armed son of Vasava, that slayer of hostile heroes, fulfill his vow?" Even thus did they then think.

sa: तदिदं मामनुप्राप्तं विभीषणवचः शुभम्। यदज्ञानान्मया तस्य न गृहीतं महात्मनः॥ विभीषणवचस्तावत्कुम्भकर्णप्रहस्तयोः। विनाशोऽयं समुत्पनो मां वीडयति दारुणः॥
en: Now the beneficial words of Vibhīşaņa have been verified. And as through blindness I did not accept the advice of that high-souled one, Kumbhakarņa and of Prahasta, this disaster arisen, shame me sore.

sa: मा स्म सीमन्तिनी काचिज्जनयेत् पुत्रमीदृशम्। मा धूमाय ज्वलात्यन्तमाक्रम्य जहि शात्रवान्॥
en: Let no woman bring forth such a son; do not smoke away but blaze up and exercising your prowess slay your enemies.

sa: पश्य वेश्मानि रौक्माणि मातले राजतानि च। कर्मणा विधियुक्तेन युक्तान्युपगतानि च॥
en: See these mansions, O Matali, made of gold and silver and embroidered with suitable workmanship filled up according to their scientific principles.

sa: भातृवत् स्वसृवच्चैव नित्यं दुहितृवच्च ये॥ परदारेषु वर्तन्ते ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः।
en: Those men who treat the wives of other people as their own mothers and sisters and daughters, succeed in attaining to Heaven.

sa: ततः पुरुषशार्दूलो पानीयहरणे गतौ। तौ ददर्श हतौ तत्र भ्रातरौ श्वेतवाहनः॥
en: (Having arrived at that lake), Shvetavahana beheld his two brothers, those most valiant of men, who came to fetch water, lying dead.

sa: तन्ममैवैष सत्कारो लाभश्चैवोत्तमः प्रभो। यत्त्वमिच्छसि सौहार्द वानरेण मया सह ॥
en: That you, O lord, are anxious to contract friendship with me who am a monkey does me honour and is my gain.

sa: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि यानि देयानि भारते। वाच्यमाने तु विप्रेभ्यो राजन् पर्वणि पर्वणि॥ जाति देशं च सत्यं च माहात्म्यं भरतर्षभ। धर्मं वृत्तिं च विज्ञाय क्षत्रियाणां नराधिप।॥
en: After this I shall declare what should be given away, as each Parvan is reached of the Bharata in course of its recitation, to Brahmanas, after ascertaining their birth country, truthfulness, and greatness, O chief of Bharata's race, as also their inclination for piety, and to Kshatriyas too, o king, after ascertainment of similar details.

sa: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्। देवी सरस्वती व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत्॥
en: Having saluted Narayana, and Nara the foremost of all male beings, as also the goddess of learning Sarasvati, let us cry success.

sa: न तु मामिह तिष्ठन्तं पश्यसि त्वं गदाधरम्। धराधरमिवाकम्प्यं पर्वतं धातुभिश्चितम्॥
en: You do not see me staying here mace in hand, like a moveless mountain dyed in metals, bearing mobile and immobile things.

sa: अन्यथा वर्तमानस्य नासौ वृत्तिः प्रकल्प्यते। कर्मणा वर्धते धर्मो यथाधर्मस्तथैव सः॥
en: A Kshatriya should never maintain a Brahmana acting otherwise. His religious merit increases for his acts. A Brahmana, indeed, is like Dharma.

sa: ततः शौरि नृयुक्तेन बहुमूल्येन भारत। यानेन महता पार्थो बहिर्निष्क्रामयत् तदा॥
en: Then Partha caused the body of his uncle lo be carried out on a rich vehicle borne on the shoulders of men.

sa: हनूमान्यदि मे न स्याद्वानराधिपतेः सखा। प्रवृत्तिमपि को वेत्तुं जानक्याः शक्तिमान्भवेत्।।१०
en: What more, had not Hanumăn, the friend of the king of monkeys-Sugrīva, been in my company who could have brought Sītā intelligence?

sa: तच्छुत्वाधृतिमास्थाय कर्मणा प्रतिपादय। प्रतिपाद्य तु राजेन्द्र ततः क्षिप्रं ज्वरं जहि॥
en: O king of kings, hearing it from me, accomplish the act with patience. Having accomplished it, soon destroy your this (mental) fever.

sa: प्रायेण च निमित्तानामीदृशानां समुद्भवे। राजा हि मृत्युमाप्नोति घोरां चापदमृच्छति ॥
en: It generally happens that when such signs manifest themselves, the king comes by a terrible calamity, and may meet with death itself.

sa: तमुत्तङ्कः प्रत्युवाच कृतक्षण एवास्मि शीघ्रमिच्छामि। यथोपपन्नममुपस्कृतं भवतेति तथेत्युक्त्वा यथोपपन्नेनान्नेनैनं भोजयामास॥
en: Uttanka said, "Yes, I shall wait. Bring soon the provisions that are ready.” The king, having signified his assent, duly entertained Uttanka.

sa: वक्तुमिच्छामि तु सखे यथा जानासि मां पुरा। न तथा वित्तवानस्मि क्षीणं वित्तं च मे सखे।॥
en: O friend, I want to tell you however that I am not the same wealthy man that you knew me to be in days of old. O friend, my wealth has been diminished

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स्वर्ग त्रिविष्टपं प्राप्य तव पूर्वपितामहाः। युधिष्ठिरप्रभृतयो यदकुर्वत तच्छृणु॥
en: Vaishampayana said Listen now to what your grandsires, Yudhishthira and others, did after having attained to Heaven, that place of the deities.

sa: कैकेय्याः प्रियकामेन रामः प्रव्राजितो वनम्। यदि सत्यं ब्रवीम्येतत् तदसत्यं भविष्यति॥
en: If I shall truthfully say I have sent Rāma to the woods for compassing Kaikeyi's pleasure, that will count for a falsehood.

sa: कराभ्यां च विकीर्णाभ्यां पपात भुवि दूषणः। विषाणाभ्यां विशीर्णाभ्यां मनस्वीव महागजः॥
en: And like a nighty elephant whose husks have fallen off, Dūşana, on his arms having been severed, fell down to the earth.

sa: तमब्रवीनृपः सूतं नायं कालो विलम्बितुम्। बाहुकस्त्वब्रवीदेनं परं यत्नं समास्थितः॥ प्रतीक्षस्व मुहूर्तं त्वमथवा त्वरते भवान्। एष याति शिवः पन्था याहि वार्ष्णेयसारथिः॥
en: The monarch asked the charioteer not to lose any time. But Bahuka, with great humility, answered him, saying, "Do you wait for a moment; or, if you are in a hurry, go then with Varshneya, as your charioteer. The way goes smooth and straight."

sa: भीष्म उवाच एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं सम्भूता मानवा यथा। नारदोऽपि यथा श्वेतं द्वीपं स गतवानृषिः। तत् ते सर्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्वैकमना नृप।॥
en: Bhishma said I have thus told you everything regarding the origin of the spiritual sons of Brahman. Listen to me with rapt attention, for I shall now describe to you how the celestial Rishi Narada had proceeded in days of yore to White Island."

sa: ततो गच्छेदनरकं तीर्थसेवी नराधिप। तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् न दुर्गतिमवाप्नुयात्॥ तत्र ब्रह्मा स्वयं नित्यं देवैः सह महीपते। अन्वास्ते पुरुषव्याघ्र नारायणपुरोगमैः॥
en: O ruler of men, then the pilgrim should go to Anaraka. O king, bathing there one never meets with any difficulty. O ruler of earth, O foremost of men, there Brahma himself accompanied by the celestials with Narayana at their head is always present.

sa: द्रोणेन दुपदं संख्ये पश्य माधव पातितम्। महाद्विपमिवारण्ये सिंहेन महता हतम्॥
en: Look, O Madhava, at king Drupada overthrown in battle by Drona, like mighty elephant in the forest killed by a huge lion.

sa: क्रीडन्ती राजहंसेन पद्मषण्डेषु नित्यशः। हंसी सा तृणमध्यस्थं कथं द्रक्ष्येत मद्गुकम्॥
en: How can the female that has always ‘sported with her mate amidst lotuses, cast her eyes on a shag staying among rushes.

sa: तथोक्ता सा तु विप्रेण कुन्ती कौतुहलान्विता। कन्या सती देवमर्कमाजुहाव यशस्विनी॥
en: Having been thus told by the Brahmana, (Durvasa) the illustrious Kunti (Pritha), being curious, invoked in her maidenhood the god Arka (Sun).

sa: एवमुक्तस्तदा भीमो यक्षेणामिततेजसा। अनुक्त्वैव तु तान् प्रश्नान् पीत्वैव निपपात ह॥
en: Thus addressed by that Yaksha of unrivalled energy, soon as Bhima without answering his questions, drank of it, he fell down dead.

sa: भृशं क्रुद्धश्च तेजस्वी नाराचेन समार्पयत्। चित्रसेनं महाराज तव पुत्रं महायशाः॥
en: Then excited to fury, that hero endued with great fame and energy, afflicted your son Chitrasena, O monarch, with a long shaft.

sa: ततो यथावद् रामेण स राज्ञो गुरुरर्चितः। अभ्यनुज्ञाप्य काकुत्स्थं ययौ रामनिवेशनात्॥
en: Then having been duly worshipped by Rāma, and taken Kākutstha's permission, the spiritual preceptor of the king, went away from Rāma's residence.

sa: रक्ष्यमाणो मया नित्यं वीरः सततमात्मवान्। कथं त्वामत्यतिक्रान्तः शापं जानन् वनौकसः॥
en: “Thus self controlled hero was always watched by me with care. How did he embrace you, knowing the curse of the Rishi.”

sa: तदा वृत्रवधं सर्वमखिलेन स लक्ष्मणः। कथयित्वा नरश्रेष्ठः कथाशेष प्रचक्रमे॥ ततो हते महावीर्ये वृत्रे देवभयंकरे। ब्रह्महत्यावृतः शक्रः संज्ञां लेभे न वृत्रहा॥
en: Having thus described at length and finished the story of Vſtra's destruction Lakşmaņa said:-The mighty Vţtra, the terror of the deities, being slain, and the slayer Indra being assailed by the sin of Brahmanicide, was bewildered and at a loss to ascertain his duty.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच पक्षपातो महानस्या विशेषेण धनञ्जये। तस्यैतत् फलमद्यैषा भुङ्क्ते पुरुषसत्तम॥
en: Yudhishthira said, She had great partiality for Dhananjaya in particular. She obtains the fruit of that conduct today, O best of men.

sa: स हि सागरपर्यन्तां महीं साधितुमर्हति। त्वनिमित्तो हि रामस्य जयो जनकनन्दिनि॥
en: For you, he prepare himself to conquer the Earth bounded by the main; and victory, you daughter of Janaka, shall be Rāma's.

sa: प्रसाधनं च केशानामञ्जनं दन्तधावनम्। पूर्वाह्न एव कार्याणि देवतानां च पूजनम्॥
en: One should dress one's hair, apply collyrium to one's eyes, and wash one's teeth, as also worship the celestials in the forenoon.

sa: निवृत्तेषु तु पाण्डूनां पुनः सैन्येषु भारत। आसीनिष्ठानका घोरस्तत सैन्यस्य संयुगे॥
en: Then, O Bharata, when the Pandava forces rallied, a dreadful and fierce roar was sent up by your troops in that battle.

sa: त्वामेकमाहुः पुरुषं त्वामाहुः सात्वतां पतिम्। नामभिस्त्वां बहुविधैः स्तुवन्ति प्रयता द्विजाः॥
en: You have been called the One only Being. You are the refuge of all worshippers. The Rishis worship you under various names.

sa: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं त्वत्तो विधास्यामस्ततो वयम्। एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच सर्वांस्ताशशलक्षणः॥ शापस्य लक्षणं चैव यक्ष्माणं च तथाऽऽत्मनः। देवास्तथा वचः श्रुत्वा गत्वा दक्षमथाब्रुवन्॥
en: Hearing your answer, we shall do what is needed for removing your fear.” Thus addressed the god, having the hare for his mark, replied to them and informed them of the cause of the curse and of the phthisis with which he was attacked.

sa: मुक्तशापं वनं तच्च तस्मिन्नेव तदाहनि। रमणीयं विबभ्राज यथा चैत्ररथं वनम्॥
en: And being thus freed from all disturbances, from that day forth that forest appeared charming, even like to the forest of Caitraratha.

sa: अहं तु विस्मयं विप्र न गच्छामीति पश्य माम्। एवमुक्त्वा नरश्रेष्ठ महादेवेनधीमता॥ अङ्गुल्यचेण राजेन्द्र स्वाङ्गुष्ठस्ताडितोऽनघ। ततो भस्म क्षताद् राजन् निर्गतं हिमसंनिभम्॥
en: "O Brahmana, I am not at all astonished. Behold me." O foremost of men, O sinless king, having thus addressed him, Mahadeva pressed his thumb by the tip of his own finger. O king, then from that wound came out ashes white as snow.

sa: स तथा चिन्तयंस्तत्र देव्या धर्मपरिग्रहम्। शुश्राव हनुमांस्तत्र चारणानां महात्मनाम् ॥
en: And as Hanumān was thinking of the magnitude of that revered lady's religious merit, he heard the converse there of high-souled Caranas.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच उपप्लव्ये निविष्टेषु पाण्डवेषु महात्मसु। प्रेषितो धृतराष्ट्रस्य समीपं मधुसूदनः॥ शमं प्रति महाबाहो हितार्थं सर्वदेहिनाम्।
en: Vaishampayana said After the great Pandavas had taken up their post at Upaplavya, they sent Krishna to Dhritarashtra for the object of peace, O mighty-armed one and for the behoof of all creatures.

sa: मम शल्यमनुद्धृत्य बान्धवानां महाबल। शत्रुसैन्यं प्रताप्यैकः क्व मां संत्यज्य गच्छसि॥
en: O exceedingly powerful one, leaving me (alone) whither did you wend, without extracting my dart as well as that of your friends?

sa: यो यथा वर्तते यस्मिंस्तस्मिन्नेव प्रवयर्तयन्। नाधर्मं समवाप्नोति न चाश्रेयश्च विन्दति॥
en: Such a one as myself who treats such according to his merit does not act unrighteously and does not come by evils.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच त्वं वै ज्येष्ठो ज्यैष्ठिनेयः पुत्र मा पाण्डवान् द्विषः। द्वेष्टा ह्यसुखमादत्ते यथैव निधनं तथा॥
en: Dhritarashtra said You are my eldest son, born of my eldest wife. Therefore, O son, be not jealous of the Pandavas, He who is jealous is always unhappy and suffer the death pangs.

sa: एवमुक्तो गुडाकेशः प्रगृह्य सशरं धनुः। आमुक्तखङ्गो मेधावी तत् सरः प्रत्यपद्यत॥
en: Thus spoken to, the intellectual Gudakesha taking up his bow together with arrows and his naked sword soon proceeded towards that lake.

sa: विकारं न ह्यजनयत् सुतीक्ष्णमपि तद् विषम्। भीमसंहनने भीमे अजीर्यत वृकोदरे॥
en: Through that poison was greatly virulent, though it was intended for killing Bhima, it produced no effects on Bhima; he digested it.

sa: निहत्यैतानि चत्वारि मायां प्रति विधाय च। ततः शक्नोति शत्रूणां प्रहर्तुमविचारयन्॥
en: That king who can overcome these four shortcomings and counteract the deceitful expedients of his enemies, succeeds, forsooth, in smiting them all.

sa: वाचा मधुरया रामः सर्वं सम्मानयञ्जनम्। मातुः समीपं धर्मात्मा प्रविवेश महायशाः॥
en: The pious Rāma, having high fame, entered into the presence of his mother, manifesting great regards for the people with sweet speech.

sa: तिस्रः कोट्यस्तु तीर्थानां सरके कुरुनन्दन॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, thirty millions of Tirthas are in Saraka.

sa: समायुक्तो महाराज स्थः पार्थस्य धीमतः। वासुदेवश्च संयन्ता योद्धा चैव धनंजयः॥
en: O great king, the wise son of Pritha has a chariot which has Vasudeva for its driver and Dhananjaya as the soldier.

sa: अपरे दुर्जयं रक्षो जानन्तः प्राज्ञसंमताः। जिताः स्म इत्यभाषन्त राक्षसं बलदर्पितम्॥
en: While other men of wisdom, knowing the Räkşasa to be invincible, said to the Rākṣasas elated with strength, "We have been conquered?”

sa: दीर्घायुषस्तव सुता यथोवाच महामुनिः। आगमिष्यति ते पुत्रः प्रीति चोत्पादयिष्यति॥ तु
en: The great Rishi say that your sons would be long lived. (Therefore) that son (Bhima) will surely return and gladden your heart.

sa: स रामप्रतिकूलानि चकार सह बन्धुभिः। आयासं जनयामास रामस्य च महात्मनः॥
en: With his kinsmen he began to do many deeds while were hostile to Rama, and caused much trouble to that grcat hero.

sa: काल: पचति भूतानि सर्वाण्येवात्मनात्मनि। यस्मिस्तु पच्यते कालस्तं वेदेह न कश्चन॥
en: Time, by its own power, cooks all entities within itself. No one, however, knows That in which Time, again, is itself cooked.

sa: अहश्च सुदिनं चैव द्वे तीर्थे लोकविश्रुते। तयोः स्नात्वा नरव्याघ्र सूर्यलोकमवाप्नुयात्॥१००।
en: There are two celebrated Tirthas called Ahan and Sudina. O foremost of men, bathing there one goes to the regions of Surya.

sa: एतस्मिन्नपराधे त्वां शिरसाहं प्रसादये। योषितो हि सदा रक्ष्याः स्वापराद्धापि नित्यशः॥
en: For my this fault, I bow down my head to you to ask for your grace. A woman, however guilty, deserves protection.”

sa: द्रव्याद् द्रव्यस्य निर्वृत्तिरिन्द्रियादिन्द्रियं तथा। देहाद् देहमवाप्नोति बीजाद् बीजं तथैव च॥
en: Objects originate from objects; the senses from the senses. From body one acquires a body, as a seed is obtained from seed.

sa: ते हनिष्यन्ति पार्थानां तानासाद्य महारथान्। वरान् वरान् महेष्वासान् क्षत्रियाणां धुरन्धरान्॥
en: Having encountered many car warriors, chiefs of bowmen and leaders of Kshatriyas on the side of Parthas they will forsooth kill them

sa: एवमुक्त्वा ययौ रामः कुरुक्षेत्रं युयुत्सया। प्रविश्य नगरं चाहं सत्यवत्यै न्यवेदयम्॥
en: Rama, saying this, went to Kurukshetra with the desire of war and I too entering the city submitted every thing to Satyavati.

sa: ब्राह्मणेषूत्तमा वृत्तिस्तव नित्यं युधिष्ठिर। तेन ते सर्वलोकेषु दीप्यते प्रथितं यशः॥
en: O Yudhishthira, you have always highly respected the Brahmanas, it is for this that your reputation shines brilliantly in the three worlds.

sa: चरन् स विविधान् मार्गान् रथेन रथसत्तमः। त्रिगर्तानां सुशर्माणमार्च्छद् रुक्मरथं रणे॥
en: And slaying eight hundred horses, five mighty car-warriors, that foremost of charioteers began to display many manuvaeres in that field of battle.

sa: ततो गते दारुके केशवोऽथ दृष्ट्वान्तिके बभ्रुमुवाच वाक्यम्। स्त्रियो भवान् रक्षितुं यातु शीघ्र नैता हिंस्युर्दस्यवो वित्तलोभात्॥
en: After Daruka had departed, Keshava, seeing Vabhru waiting on him, told him these words 'Do you go speedily for protecting the ladies. Let not robbers do them any injury, tempted by the riches.

sa: बुद्धिविज्ञानसम्पन्न इङ्गितैः सर्वमाचर। नह्यबुद्धिं गतो राजा सर्वभूतानि शास्ति हि ॥
en: Gifted with intellect and knowledge do you perforin all by means of gestures. A king void of sense cannot govern all creatures.

sa: सैक्यायसानि वर्माणि कांस्यानि च समन्ततः॥ भित्त्वा देहांस्तथा तेषां शरा जग्मुर्महीतलम्।
en: Those arrows, penetrating through the iron or brass armours of the Yavanas as also their bodies, then fell down on the earth.

sa: स ध्यात्वा सुचिरं कालं दुःखरोषसमन्वितः। श्वसमानो यथा नागः प्रणुन्नो वाक्शलाकया।॥
en: Thus mutilated with those 'worldly daggers' and sighing like a snake, and meditating for a while, and possessed with rage and sorrow,

sa: शतं निष्कसहस्राणि गवां चाप्ययुतानि षट्। उत्थायोत्थाय स प्रादात् परिसंवत्सरान् शतम्॥
en: And for several successive centuries he gave to the Brahmanas hundred thousand Nishkas and sixty-thousand kine, at the time of his rising.

sa: तथा स्तवो वरिष्ठोऽयं स्तवानां ब्रह्मसम्मितः॥ यशोराज्यसुखैश्चर्यकामार्थधनकाङ्गिभिः। श्रोतव्यो भक्तिमास्थाय विद्याकामैश्च यत्नतः॥
en: Persons seeking fame, kingdom, happiness, pleasure, profit and riches, and learning, should listen with devout feelings to the recital of this hymn.

sa: ततः सीतां महाभागां दृष्ट्वा तां धर्मचारिणीम्। सान्त्वयन्त्यब्रवीद् वृद्धा दिष्ट्या धर्ममवेक्षसे॥
en: Seeing the virtuous Sītā engaged in righteous acts, the old lady consoling her, said "By luck it is that you regard righteousness."

sa: इति सूतो नरेन्द्रेण चोदितः सज्जमानया। उवाच वाचा राजानं स बाष्पपरिबद्धया॥
en: Thus urged by the king, the charioteer spoke to the king with his voice faltering and suppressed with the vapour of grief.

sa: दीयतां सम्प्रदानं च परिष्वज्य च वानरान्। सर्वशाखामृगेन्द्रस्त्वं संसाधय सुहृज्जनम् ॥
en: Embracing all the monkeys, inviting all your friends, do you, that are the lord of the monkey herds, honour them with gifts.

sa: भक्षयन्तं महाघोरानृक्षसिंहमृगद्विजान्। घोरौ भुजौ विकुर्वाणमुभौ योजनमायतौ॥ कराभ्यां विविधान् गृह्य ऋक्षान् पक्षिगणान् मृगान्। आकर्षन्तं विकर्षन्तमनेकान् मृगयूथपान्॥
en: And stretching forth its two huge arms extending over a Yojana it was devouring bears, lions and deer. It was catching and throwing with its huge hands many an animal, bird and bear.

sa: रामस्तु सहितो भ्रात्रा सीतया च परंतपः। सुतीक्ष्णस्याश्रमपदं जगाम सह तैर्द्विजैः॥
en: And Rāma accompanied by his brother as well as Sītā went to the asylum of Sutīksna in company with the twice-born ones.

sa: स महाबाहुरत्यर्थं प्रसार्य विपुलौ भुजौ। जग्राह सहितावेव राघवो पीडयन् बलात्॥
en: Thereupon that one, of huge arms, stretching them forth, got hold of those two descendants of Raghu crushing them with its strength.

sa: सुप्तेव पुनरुत्थाय आर्यपुत्रेति वादिनी। रुरोद सा पतिं दृष्ट्वा संवीतं मृत्युदामभिः॥
en: And thereupon rising again like one asleep, she, beholding her husband engarlanded by death, cried aloud, exclaiming O son of worshipful sire.

sa: इदं तु दु:खं यदनर्थकानि मे व्रतानि दानानि च संयमाश्च हि। तपश्च तप्तं यदपत्यकाम्यया सुनिष्फलं बीजमिवोप्तमूषरे॥
en: This distresses me that all my religious vows, alms giving, self-restraint and austerity, performed with a view of obtaining a son, have been fruitless, like to the seeds thrown on a barren soil.

sa: स पुनः पतितां दृष्ट्वा क्रोधाच्छूर्पणखां पुनः। उवाच व्यक्तया वाचा तामनर्थार्थमागताम्॥
en: Seeing Sūrpanakhă again lying on the ground, Khara in anger spoke out to that one, who had come to bring on evil.

sa: कर्नागसहस्रं तु विजज्ञे धरणीधरान्। द्वौ पुत्रौ विनतायास्तु गरुडोऽरुण एव च॥
en: And Kadru gave birth to a thousand Nāgas with the holder of the Earth. And Vinatā brought forth two sons-Garuda and Aruna.

sa: ततो ज्ञातिवधं श्रुत्वा रावणः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः।॥ सहायं वरयामास मारीचं नाम राक्षसम्।
en: Having learnt of the destruction of his relatives, Rāvaņa wrought into frenzy by anger, sought the help of a Rākşasa named Mārīca.

sa: चार्यमाणः सु.हुशो मारीचेन स रावणः॥ न विरोधो बलवता क्षमो रावण तेन ते। अनादृत्य तु तद्वाक्यं रावणः कालचोदितः॥ जगाम सहमारीचस्तस्याश्रमपदं तदा।
en: And although strongly dissuaded by Mārīca, saying. You ought not to enter into hostilities with that powerful one. Do you, therefore, O Ravana, excuse me! yet, disregarding those words of his, Ravana, urged on by Fate, went into that asylum in company with Mārīca.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा सुरान् सर्वाशशाप पृथिवीमपि। अवने नैकरूपा त्वं बहुभार्या भविष्यसि ॥
en: Having thus spoke to the celestials, she cursed the Earth also, saying, 'O Earth, you will have multiform surface and many husbands.'

sa: सीतया सह निर्यातो विना सीतामुपागतः॥ कथं नाम प्रवेक्ष्यामि शून्यमन्तःपुरं मम।
en: I came out with Sītā and shall return home without her. How shall I enter again that inner apartment void of Sitā?

sa: ततो मन्दाकिनीतीरं प्रत्युत्तीर्य स राघवः। पितुश्चकार तेजस्वी निर्वापं भ्रातृभिः सह॥
en: Then drawing nigh to the marge of the Mandākinī, the energetic Rāghava along with his brothers, offered the Pinda to his father.

sa: इच्छामो हि महाबाहुं रघुवीरं महाबलम्। गजेन महता यान्तं रामं छत्रावृताननम्॥
en: We wish to behold the exceedingly strong and mighty-armed hero among the Raghus, riding a huge elephant, his countenance underneath an umbrella.

sa: एवं विलप्य बहुशो राक्षसी प्रदरोदरी॥ भ्रातुः समीपे शोकार्ता नष्टसंज्ञा बभूव ह। कराभ्यामुदरं हत्वा रुरोद भृशदुःखिता॥
en: Having thus bewailed long, that Raksasi, possessed of a spacious abdomen, through sorrow, became bereft of her senses before her brother, and exercised with great grief cried, striking her abdomen with her hands.

sa: ततः प्रभाते जनकः कृतकर्मा महर्षिभिः। उवाच वाक्यं वाक्यज्ञः शतानन्दं पुरोहितम्॥
en: Then next morning Janaka skilled in speech, having in company with the Maharsis performed his daily duties, addressed the priest Satānanda, saying

sa: दुःखिताः खरघातेन राक्षसाः पिशिताशनाः। तैः सीता निहता घोरैर्भविष्यति न संशयः॥
en: The Rākşasas subsisting flesh are aggrieved because of Khara having been slain; and now, without doubt, those terrible ones have slain Sita.

sa: अब्रवीच्च दशग्रीवः पिशाची?रदर्शनाः॥ यथा नैनां पुमान् स्त्री वा सीतां पश्यत्यसम्मतः।
en: Then the Ten-headed one spoke to some female friends of terrible visages, Let no man or woman behold Sītā without my permission.

sa: पश्य चन्दनवृक्षाणां पङ्क्तीः सुरुचिरा इव। ककुभानां च दृश्यन्ते मनसैवोदिताः समम्॥
en: Behold there the rows of pleasant sandal trees and those Kukubhas which have grown up as it were like to mental emotion.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महाराजो विभागं लोकसंनिधौ। व्यादिश्य च महाराजो दिवं दशरथो गतः॥
en: Having made this division of duties in the presence of all, and also enjoined this, the mighty monarch, Dasaratha, has ascended heaven.

sa: नृशंसमनृशंसं वा प्रजारक्षणकारणात्। पातकं वा सदोषं वा कर्तव्यं रक्षता सदा॥
en: Whether an act be cruel or otherwise, slightly or highly sinful, it should for protecting the subjects, be performed by a ruler.

sa: अहोऽस्मि परमप्रीतः प्रभावश्चातुलो मम। यन्मे ज्येष्ठं प्रियं पुत्रं यौवराज्यस्थमिच्छथ ॥
en: Exceedingly pleased am I, and incomparable also is my influence, because you wish to behold my dear first born installed as heir-apparent.

sa: अलंकृतोऽयं देशश्च यत्र सौमित्रिणा सह। वैदेह्या चानया राम वत्स्यसि त्वमरिंदम॥
en: This region, O Rāma, will be adorned, since, O subduer of enemies, you along with Vaidehī and Sumitra's son, will dwell here.

sa: तद् वाक्यं करुणं राज्ञः श्रुत्वा दीनस्य भाषितम्। बाष्पं प्रणालीव नवोदकम्॥
en: Having heard these piteous words of the distressed king, Kausalyā uttered words even as a water-way lets out fresh accession of rain.

sa: ततः सर्वा दिशो राजा चोदयित्वा यथातथम्। कपिसेनापतिर्वीरो मुमोद सुखितः सुखम्॥
en: Then, having properly despatched (his forces) in all directions, that general of the monkey hosts, being pleased, gave himself up to sport.

sa: स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय सुमन्त्रो राजशासनात्॥ रामं तत्रानयांचक्रे रथेन रथिनां वरम्।
en: Thereupon saying, "so be it” Sumantra at the mandate of the king brought thither in a car Rāma the foremost of car-warriors.

sa: नास्ति धर्मः कुतः सत्यं नार्जवं नानृशंसता। यत्र रामस्य वैदेही सीतां हरति रावणः॥ इता भूतानि सर्वाणि गणशः पर्यदेवयन्। वित्रस्तका दीनमुखा रूरुदुर्मुगपोतकाः॥
en: Virtue is not; and where is truth? And there is neither sincerity nor kindness, in a case in which Rāvana is carrying away Rāma's Vaidehī; thus did all creatures lament in numbers. And the young of deer, afflicted with fear, wept with woe-began faces.

sa: विविधान्यपि यानानि महान्ति च लघूनि च। प्रययुः सुमहार्हाणि पादैरपि पदातयः॥
en: And then proceeded various kinds of cars great and light of movement and of high value; and the infantry went on foot.

sa: तस्यास्तद् विमलं वक्त्रमाकाशे रावणाङ्कगम्। न रराज विना रामं विनालमिव पङ्कजम्॥
en: And her blameless countenance on Rāvana's lap in the sky did not appear beauteous without Rāma, like a lotus without its stalk;

sa: मुद्गरैरायसैः शूलैः प्रासैः खङ्गैः परश्वधैः। राक्षसाः समरे शूरं निजघ्नू रोषतत्पराः॥
en: And wrought up with rage, the Rākṣasas in battle assailed him with iron clubs, and darts, and prāsas, and swords, and axes.

sa: प्रयाणमिति च श्रुत्वा राजराजस्य योषितः॥ हित्वा यानानि यानार्दा ब्राह्मणं पर्यवारयन्।
en: Hearing of their departure, the wives of that king of kings, leaving their cars, albeit worthy of them, gathered round the Brāhmaṇa.

sa: जृम्भितं तद् धनुर्दृष्ट्वा शैवं विष्णुपराक्रमैः॥ अधिकं मेनिरे विष्णुं देवाः सर्षिगणास्तथा।
en: Upon beholding that bow of Śiva rendered flaccid by Vişnu's prowess, the deities with the saints acknowledged Vişņu as the more powerful.

sa: एवं विलपती तारां पतिशोकपरिवृताम्। उत्थापयन्ति स्म तदा वानर्यः शोककर्शिताः। ४८।।
en: The other she-monkeys, worked with sorrow, raised up Tārā bewailing thus being exercised with grief consequent upon the demise of her husband.

sa: सवैजयन्तास्तु गजा गजारोहैः प्रचोदिताः। तरन्तः स्म प्रकाशन्ते सपक्षा इव पर्वताः॥
en: And elephants graced with flags ing spurred on by their riders, began to cross the stream, appearing like (so many) winged hills.

sa: राज्यं प्राप्तं यशश्चैव कौली श्रीरभिवर्धिता।।९ मित्राणां संग्रहः शेषस्तद् भवान् कर्तुमर्हति।
en: You have attained your kingdom, fame, and your vast ancestral wealth. It now behoveth you to perform your duties by your friends.

sa: निविश्य वदनं मेऽद्य गन्तव्यं वानरोत्तम। वर एष पुरा दत्तो मम धात्रेति सत्वरा ॥ व्यादाय विपुलं वक्त्रं स्थिता सा मारुतेः पुरः।
en: O best of monkeys, you shall have to go, today after entering my mouth. Even this is the boon that was conferred on me by the Deity. Having said this swiftly, she extending her capacious mouth wide, stood in front of the wind-god's son.

sa: प्रविश्य प्रथमां कक्ष्यां द्वितीयायां ददर्श सः। ब्राह्मणान् वेदसम्पन्नान् वृद्धान् राज्ञाभिसत्कृतान्॥
en: Having passed through the first apartment he saw in the second, many.old Brahmanas, versed in the Vedas and honoured by the king.

sa: ये चैनमभिवर्तन्ते याचितार इतस्ततः। यच्च यत्र यथावच्च सर्वे तेभ्यः प्रयच्छति॥
en: He duly confer upon such as repair to him from various quarters all those things that they ask for. And do yourself.

sa: इति सर्वा महिष्यस्ता विवत्सा इव धेनवः। पतिमाचुक्रुशुश्चापि सस्वनं चापि चुक्रुशुः॥
en: Thus the queens of Dasaratha, like to the cows that have lost their young ones, began to blame him and cry aloud.

sa: यन्मङ्गलं सुपर्णस्य विनताकल्पयत् पुरा। अमृतं प्रार्थयानस्य तत् ते भवतु मङ्गलम्॥
en: May that blessing attend you, which was invoked in olden times by Vinatā, for that king of birds Garuda, praying for nectar.

sa: रावणं सहिताः सर्वे राक्षसं कामरूपिणम्। सीतया सह वैदेह्या मार्गध्वमिति चोदिताः॥
en: And we have been commissioned, 'Do you all search for the Rākşasa Rāvana, wearing forms at will, along with Videha's daughter, Sītā.'

sa: तथा तु विलपन्तीं तां कौसल्यां राममातरम्। उवाच लक्ष्मणो दीनस्तत्कालसदृशं वचः॥
en: At this time Laksmana, sorely distressed, addressed the weeping Kausalyā, the mother of Rāma with the following words suitable to that occasion.

sa: वधं खरत्रिशिरसोरुत्थानं रावणस्य च। मारीचस्य वधं चैव वैदेह्या हरणं तथा॥
en: And the slaughter of Khara and Trisiras; and the exertions of Rāvana; the killing of Mārīca, and the carrying away of Vaidehī.

sa: सर्वेषां परितुष्टाऽस्मि वानराणां तरस्विनाम्॥ चरन्त्या मम धर्मेण न कार्यमिह केनचित्।
en: Well pleased am I with the fast-footing monkeys. But by one engaged in your duties, there is no work that is desiderated.

sa: ते विषादातवदना रहितास्तेन धीमता। कृपणाः करुणा वाचो वदन्ति स्म मनीषिणः॥
en: And those intelligent ones, extremely distressed on being deprived of Rāma endowed with understanding, with countenance betokening sorrow, spoke these piteous words.

sa: धन्वः खलु महाभागो लक्ष्मणः शुभलक्षणः। भ्रातरं विषमे काले यो राममनुवर्तते॥
en: Surely the mighty-armed Lakşmaņa graced with auspicious marks is blessed, he who in the time of dire adversity follows his brother Rāma.

sa: अयं पितुर्वयस्यो मे गृध्रराजो महाबलः। शेते विनिहतो भूमौ मम भाग्यविपर्ययात्॥
en: This mighty king of vultures is our father's friend and he Leith on earth, killed through the evil turn of my fortune.

sa: तस्यैषा लोकनाथस्य धर्मपत्नी यशस्विनी॥ सीता नाम वरारोहा यां त्वं हर्तुमिच्छसि।
en: This exquisitely beautiful and far-famed Sītā whom you are about to steal away, is the married wife of that lord of men.

sa: ध्रुवं तु भरतं रामः प्राप्य राज्यमकण्टकम्। देशान्तरं नाययिता लोकान्तरमथापि वा॥
en: For certain, Rāma having attained the kingdom without let, will send Bharata either to a distant land, or to the other world.

sa: कच्चिद् वृदांश्च बालांश्च वैद्यान् मुख्यांश्च राघव। दानेन मनसा वाचा त्रिभिरेतैर्बुभूषसे॥
en: And do you with these three, gifts, mind and word, try to win over aged people, boys, physicians, and the principal ones?

sa: अनेन धर्मशीलेन वनात् प्रत्यागतः पुनः भ्रात्रा सह भविष्यामि पृथिव्याः पतिरुत्तमः॥
en: Having returned from the forest, I will in company with this brother of virtuous character become the worthy master of this earth.

sa: सम्भ्रान्ताश्च सुराः सर्वे त्रैलोक्ये क्षुभिते सति। प्रसादयन्ति संक्रुद्धं मारुतं भुवनेश्वराः॥
en: Thereat, all gods-lords of the universeinfluenced by fear in consequence of the triune world waxing agitated, began to path the wrathful Wind.

sa: शैलस्य तस्य पृष्ठेषु कन्दरेषु वनेषु च। रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यस्ततस्ततः॥
en: You should search for Rāvana with Vaidehi all round the top of that mountain as well as in its forests and woods.

sa: इयं तात सुखा शय्या त्वदर्थमुपकल्पिता। प्रत्याश्वसिहि शेष्वास्यां सुखं राघवनन्दन ॥ उचितोऽयं जनः सर्वो दुःखानां त्वं सुखोचितः। धर्मात्मस्तस्य गुप्त्यर्थं जागरिष्यामहे वयम्॥
en: I said, “This easeful bed has been prepared for you, my child. O son of Raghu's descendant, cheer up! Do you lie down at ease. All these people can bear hardship; but you are meant for comfort. For protecting him religiously, we shall wake.

sa: दिशमास्थाय कैकेयि दक्षिणां दण्डकान् प्रति। वैजयन्तमिति ख्यातं पुरं यत्र तिमिध्वजः॥ स शम्बर इति ख्यातः शतमायो महासुरः। ददौ शक्रस्य संग्राम देवसङ्घरनिन्दितः॥
en: O Kaikeyī, ir Dandaka, situated towards the south, there is the city known by the name of Vaijayanta, where dwelt Timidhvaja, otherwise called Samvara, possessed of an hundred conjurations, and a mighty Asura. That unreproved gave battle Sakra one to accompanied by the celestials.

sa: अनृणः स महाबाहुः पिता दशरथस्तव। यस्य त्वमीदृशः पुत्रो धर्मात्मा धर्मवत्सलः॥
en: Your father Dasaratha has become freed from his debts, since he has a son like to you, righteous and attached to virtue.

sa: नावां शतानां पञ्चानां कैवर्तानां शतं शतम्। संनद्धानां तथा यूनां तिष्ठन्त्वित्यभ्यचोदयत्॥
en: And let hundreds upon hundreds of Kaivarta youths accoutred in mail remain in each of five hundred barks., Guha issued this order.

sa: तथा सम्भाषमाणा सा सीता गङ्गामनिन्दिता। दक्षिणा दक्षिणं तीरं क्षिप्रमेवाभ्युपागमत् ॥
en: Having thus addressed the Gangā, that blameless one ever obedient to her husband, swiftly went to the south bank (of the river).

sa: मातास्मत्कारणाद् देवी सुमित्रा दुःखमावसेत्। अयोध्यामित एव त्वं काले प्रविश लक्ष्मण॥
en: Your mother, the reversed Sumitrā, will be smitten with grief on our account. Do you, Laks maņa, tomorrow morning repair to Ayodhyā:

sa: नन्दिग्रामं गमिष्यामि सर्वानामन्त्रयेऽत्र वः। तत्र दुःखमिदं सर्वं सहिष्ये राघवं विना॥
en: I shall go to Nandigrāma, and therefore greet you all. There I shall suffer all this grief on account of Rāma's absence.

sa: त्वनिमित्तमिदं तावत् तापसान् प्रति वर्तते। रक्षोभ्यस्तेन संविग्नाः कथयन्ति मिथः कथाः॥
en: This fear arising from Rākşasas afflicts the ascetics because of you; and they, extremely agitated, converse with each other (on the subject).

sa: सर्वथा प्रायमासीनान् यदि नो भक्षयिष्यति। कृतकृत्या भविष्यामः क्षिप्रं सिद्धिमितो गताः॥
en: If he eat us up, who have sat down to fast to death, we shall secure success, and speedily attain our end.

sa: कृत्वा. निःशब्दमेकाग्राः शृण्वन्तु हरयो मम। तथ्यं संकीर्तयिष्यामि यथा जानामि मैथिलीम्॥
en: Remaining silent, do you, you monkeys, heedfully hear what I say. I will tell you truly how I came to know Maithili.

sa: स त्वनेकाग्रहृदयो द्वा:स्थं प्रत्यर्च्य तं जनम्। सूतमश्वपतेः क्लान्तमब्रवीत् तत्र राघवः॥ किमहं त्वरयानीत: कारणेन विनानघ। अशुभाशङ्कि हृदयं शीलं च पततीव मे॥
en: Then courteously telling the warders to desist, he with an agitated heart spoke to the tired charioteer of Aśvapati, “O sinless one, why have I been brought in this haste without any (adequate) reason?" My heart apprehended some evil; and my disposition gives way.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा काले साधु निरूपितम्। सुग्रीवः सत्त्वसम्पन्नश्चकार मतिमुत्तमाम्॥
en: Hearing these words of Hanumān, said on a very proper occasion, the intelligent Sugrīva, made up his mind for a worthy end.

sa: सम्पूर्णमपि चेदद्य प्रतरेयं महोदधिम्। सोऽपि नूनं ममालक्ष्म्या विशुष्येत् सरितां पतिः॥
en: If for assuaging my grief I do enter the mighty ocean, verily shall that misfortune dry up even that lord of rivers.

sa: प्रतिहारि त्वथोवाच संत्रस्ता तु कृताञ्जलिः॥ देव देवी भृशं क्रुद्धा क्रोधागारमभिद्रुता।
en: Thereupon, hurriedly and with clasped hands, the warder said, “Worshipful sire, the noble lady being exceedingly angry, has repaired to the anger-chamber."

sa: भ्रातुर्वचनमाज्ञाय लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा। चकार च यथोक्तं हि तं रामः पुनरब्रवीत्॥
en: Acquainted with the words of his brother, Lakşmaņa, slayer of hostile heroes did as he was told. Thereupon Rāma addressed him again.

sa: ततः कण्ठगतं माल्यं चित्रं बहुगणं महत्। चिच्छेद विमदश्चासीत् सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः॥
en: Then Sugriva-lord of monkeys-tore away the gaudy and variegated garland on his neck-potent with many a virtue, and become deprived of energy.

sa: नास्मि विप्रकृता देव केनचिन्नावमानिता। अभिप्रायस्तु मे कश्चित् तमिच्छामि त्वया कृतम्॥
en: O worshipful one, none has wronged or reprimanded me. I have a certain intention, which I wish that you will carry out.

sa: इति ब्रुवाणं सुग्रीवं रामो धर्मभृतां वरः। बाहुभ्यां सम्परिष्वज्य प्रत्युवाच कृताञ्जलिम्॥
en: As Sugrīva was speaking thus with joined hands, that best of the righteous, Rāma, embraced him with his arms, and then replied,

sa: राक्षसा विविधा वाचो व्याहरन्ति महावने॥ हिंसाविहारा वैदेहि न चिन्तयितुमर्हसि ।
en: O Vaidehī, to create mischief to the pious is the only amusement of these Rākşasas-you shoudst not therefore be anxious for this.

sa: स रुदित्वा चिरं कालं भूमौ परिविवृत्य च। जननी प्रत्युवाचेदं शोकैर्बहुभिरावृतः॥
en: Having wept for a long while with his body rolling on the earth, Bharata afflicted with manifold grief, answered his mother, saying.

sa: तमद्यैव प्रियार्थं मे वैरिणं भ्रातृरूपिणम्। वालिनं जहि काकुत्स्थ मया बद्धोऽमञ्जलिः॥
en: Do you, O Kākutstha, even to-day destroy, for my welfare, my brother Vāli. This I do pray to you with folded hands.

sa: अद्येमां भक्षयिष्यामि पश्यतस्तव मानुषीम्। त्वया सह चरिष्यामि निःसपत्ना यथा सुखम्॥
en: To-day, you looking on, I shall eat up this human female. And I shall, rid of a co-wife, happily range with you.

sa: वनं नगरमेवास्तु येन गच्छति राघवः। अस्माभिश्च परित्यक्तं पुरं सम्पद्यतां वनम्॥
en: Let the forest to which Rāghava repairs resemble a city, and let this city renounced by as be converted into a wilderness.

sa: ते लक्ष्मण इव क्षिप्रं सपल्यः सहबान्धवाः। गच्छन्तमनुगच्छामो येन गच्छति राघवः॥
en: Therefore, accompanied by our wives and friends will we like Lakşmaņa follow the departing Rāghava by the same way that he takes.

sa: बाष्पेण पिहितं दीनं रामः सौमित्रिणा सह। चकर्षेव गुणैर्बद्धं जनं पुरनिवासिनम्॥
en: Rāma in company with Sumitrā's attracted the inhabitants of the city subdued by his virtues, who stood with tears in their eyes.

sa: अद्य नूनं दशरथः सत्त्वमाविश्य भाषते। नहि राजा प्रियं पुत्रं विवासयितुमर्हति॥
en: Surely to-day Dasaratha speaks thus, possessed by some evil spirit; for the king ought by no means to banish his beloved son.

sa: क्व स पाणिः सुखस्पर्शस्तातस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः। यो हि मां रजसा ध्वस्तमभीक्ष्णं परिमार्जति॥
en: Where is now the soft hand of that energetic one which used to rub my person when it was covered with dust?

sa: तद्धनुः प्राप्य मे पित्रा व्याहृतं सत्यवादिना। समवाये नरेन्द्राणां पूर्वमामन्त्र्य पार्थिवान्॥
en: Having obtained the bow, my truthful father said, 'No fear!' inviting at the same time the kings to an assembly of sovereigns.

sa: सम्प्रत्येतावदेवाद्य शक्यं मे गमने स्वतः। नैतावता च संसिद्धिः कार्यस्यास्य भविष्यति॥
en: Now I can only by my own energy, course thus far. But has a bound shall not bring success on our undertaking.

sa: तस्य चिन्तयतो नित्यं धर्मेण विदितात्मनः। पुत्रो भगीरथो नाम जज्ञे परमधार्मिकः॥
en: As that pious one furnished with selfknowledge was always meditating upon this, an eminently virtuous son was born to him named Bhagiratha.

sa: तौ काष्ठसंघाटमथो चक्रतुः सुमहाप्लवम्। शुष्कैर्वंयैः समाकीर्णमुशीरैश्च समावृतम्॥ ततो वैतसशाखाश्च जम्बुशाखाश्च वीर्यवान्। चकार लक्ष्मणश्छित्त्वा सीतायाः सुखमासनम्॥
en: Then with heaps of dry wild wood covered with grass, they constructed a large raft. And the puissant Lakşmaņa tearing twigs from the ratan and the rose-apple, made a comfortable seat for Sita.

sa: कृतान्त एव सौमित्रे द्रष्टव्यो मत्प्रवासने। राज्यस्य च वितीर्णस्य पुनरेव निवर्तते॥
en: Do you regard, Oh Laksmana, destiny as the only cause of this transfer of the kingdom, although attained, and of my banishment.

sa: अहो रूपमहो लक्ष्मीः स्वरसम्पद्य शोभना। मृगोऽद्भुतो विचित्राङ्गो हृदय हरतीव मे॥
en: Ah! what beauty, what beautiful a lustre, how musical a voice, this wonderful deer of variegated countenance, has indeed captivated my heart!

sa: स चित्यो राजसिंहस्य संचितः कुशलैर्द्विजैः। गरुडो रुक्मपक्षो वै त्रिगुणोऽष्टादशात्मकः॥ नियुक्तास्तत्र पशवस्तत्तदुद्दिश्य दैवतम्। उरगाः पक्षिणश्चैव यथाशास्त्रं प्रचोदिताः॥ शामित्रे तु हयस्तत्र तथा जलचराश्च ये। ऋषिभिः सर्वमेवैतन्नियुक्तं शास्त्रतस्तदा॥
en: That fire-place of that lion among kings, set by skilful Brāhmaṇas, consisting on three sides of eighteen bricks, looked like the goldenwinged Garuda. And for the purpose of sacrificing them to the respective deities were collect beasts and reptiles, and birds, and horses, and aquatic animals. And the priests sacrificed all these in proper form.

sa: इति ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे बाष्पशोकपरिप्लुतः। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणः क्रुद्धो रुद्धो नाग इव श्वसन्॥
en: As Kākutstha with his eyes flooded with tears was speaking thus, Lakşmaņa flying into a rage, spoke like to a confined elephant:

sa: भ्रातृपुत्रसमौ चापि द्रष्टव्यौ च विशेषतः। त्वया भरतशत्रुघ्नौ प्राणैः प्रियतरौ मम॥
en: Should you specially regard Bharata and Śatrughna like to your sons or brothers, who are dearer to me than my life itself.

sa: समन्मथा तीव्रतरानुरागा कुलान्विता मन्दगतिः करेणूः। मदान्वितं सम्परिवार्य यान्तं वनेषु भर्तारमनुप्रयाति॥
en: The she-elephants, moving slowly, fond, passionate and accompanied by other members, have been following their passionate mates, in the forest, embracing them.

sa: अन्तरा मेरुमस्तं च तालो दशशिरा महान्। जातरूपमयः श्रीमान् भ्राजते चित्रवेदिकः॥
en: Between Meru and the Setting hill, towers a tall palm having ten heads. Golden and graceful, it shineth on a variegated dais.

sa: ततः परं जनस्थानात् त्रिकोशं गम्य राघवौ। क्रौञ्चारण्यं विविशतुर्गहनं तौ महौजसौ॥
en: Thereupon, the highly effulgent descendants of Raghu entered the dense forest of Krauñca, situated at a distance of six miles from Janasthāna.

sa: ते तु सर्वे हरिवराः पृथिव्यां सर्ववानरान्। संचोदयित्वा त्वरितं यूथानां जग्मुरग्रतः॥
en: And all those foremost of monkeys, taking all the monkeys of the earth, hastily set off in the van of the herds.

sa: स देव्या व्यवसायं च घोरं च शपथं कृतम्। ध्यात्वा रामेऽतिनिःश्वस्यच्छिन्नस्तरुरिवापतत्॥
en: Then recollecting that revered lady's resolve, and his own terrible oath, he, sighing forth, “O Rāma," dropped down like a felled tree.

sa: अस्त्युत्तरेण कैलासं मैनाकं पर्वतं प्रति। हिरण्यशृङ्गः सुमहान् दिव्यो मणिमयो गिरिः॥
en: Immediately north of Kailasa and near the mountain Mainaka, there is a great and beautiful mountain called Manimeya which possesses golden peaks.

sa: एवं राजन्नवहारो बभुव ततः पुनर्विमलेऽभूत् सुघोरम्। कल्यं कल्यं विंशतिं वै दिनानि तथैव चान्यानि दिनानि त्रीणि॥
en: In this way, Oking, was there an end to the fight and again was there a fierce encounter at the dawn of day and so on day after day for three twenty days.

sa: ततो द्रोणश्च पार्थश्च समेयेतां महामृधे। यथा बुधश्च शुक्रश्च महाराज नभस्तले॥
en: Then Drona and Arjuna met in that fierce battle, like, O mighty monarch, Venus and Jupiter meeting one another on the heavens.

sa: कर्मणा तेन पार्थस्य तुतुषुर्देवदानवाः। अथ क्रुद्धो रणे पार्थस्त्रिगर्तान् प्रति भारत॥
en: The celestial and the Danavas all become pleased with that feat of Pritha's Thereafter Arjuna waxing worth on the Trigaretas, O Bharata,

sa: एकाछा निर्दहेद् भीष्मः पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्॥ शरैः परमसंक्रुद्धो यदि श्वेतो न पालयेत्।
en: If Shveta did not protect it, in one single day Bhishma could have in anger consumed the Pandava army with his arrows.

sa: ततस्ते सूदिताः सर्वे मम बाणाः सुसंशिताः। रामबाणैर्द्विधा छिन्नाः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Then were all of them (Rama's followers) rejoiced at seeing my well furnished arrows cut asunder in two by hundreds and thousands.

sa: पादाताश्चापि शस्त्राणि समुत्सृज्य महारणे। निरपेक्षा व्यधावन्त तेन तेन स्म भारत॥
en: In that fierce fight, foot-soldiers, abandoning their weapons, and without paying any heed to any one, fled, O Bharata, hither and thither.

sa: करवाणि च ते कामं ब्रूहि त्वमभिकाक्षितम्। एवंगते महाराज युद्धादन्यत् किमिच्छसि॥
en: I shall also fulfill your desire. Tell me what you have to say. Battle excepted tell me what you desire to get.

sa: चित्रसेनं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्विव्याध समरे भृशम्। समागतौ तौ तु रणे महामात्रौ व्यरोचताम्॥
en: Encountering one another in battle, those two foremost of men, appeared beautiful, O king, like Venus and Saturn shining in the heavens.

sa: स्वैः स्वैरनीकैः सहिताः परिवार्य महारथम्। एते महारथाः सर्वे द्वितीये निर्ययुले॥
en: All these with their respective forces, surrounded their Maharathas, and all the Maharathas went out in the second division of the army.

sa: अथ दुर्योधनं दृष्ट्वा भीमसेनो महाबलः। विधित्सुः कलहस्यान्तं गदां जग्राह पाण्डव:॥
en: Thereafter the Pandava Bhimasena endued with great might beholding Duryodhana and desirous of putting and end to the strife, grasped his mace.

sa: त्वं हि संश्रूयसेऽत्यर्थमसाबलविक्रमः। पुत्रस्य तव तद् वाक्यं श्रुत्वा शल्यः प्रतापवान्॥
en: You are well-known for the irresistibleness of your strength and prowess.” Then hearing these words of your son, the highly puissant Shalya,

sa: प्रावर्तत ततो युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्। अस्माकं पाण्डवैः सार्धमनयात् तव भारत॥
en: Then O descendant of Bharata, a fearful and hair-stirring battle between ourselves and the Pandavas began in consequences of your sinful policy.

sa: ततो दौःशासनिः क्रुद्धो गदामुद्यम्य मारिष॥ अभिदुद्राव सौभद्रं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्।
en: Thereupon, O sire, Dushasana's invincible son excited with rage and upraising his mace, rushed against Abhimanyu crying at same time, “Wait" "Wait."

sa: तेषां वधार्थं भगवान् नरेण सहितो वशी। मानुषीं योनिमास्थाय चरिष्यति महीतले।॥
en: For slaying them, the almighty Lord of great strength, being accompanied by Nara, shall wonder over the earth assuming a human form.

sa: अधर्मः क्षत्रियस्यैष यद् व्याधिमरणं गृहे। यदयोनिधनं याति सोऽस्य धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: In a Kshatriya to die of a disease is a sin. To die in the field of battle is his eternal duty.

sa: ततः सर्वाण्यनीकानि तव पुत्रस्य शासनात्। अभ्यद्रवन् भीमसेनं नदन्तं भैरवान् रवान्॥
en: Thereat, the entire army, at the command of your son, rushed against Bhimasena, setting up at the same time a dreadful uproar.

sa: वध्यते यत्र संग्रामे किमन्यद् भागधेयतः॥ विपरीतमिदं सर्वं प्रतिभाति हि संजय।
en: Should be slain in battle, alas, what can it be due to but Destiny? All this appears to be unnatural, O Sanjaya.

sa: अथालोक्य प्रविष्टं तमूचुस्ते सर्व एव तु। जीवग्राहं निगृह्णीमो वयमेनं नराधिपाः॥
en: Then seeing him standing amongst them all those kings said; Let us torture this one till he is deprived of his life.

sa: प्रतिपालय मां सूत नियम्याश्वान् मुहूर्तकम्। यावदेतान् निहन्म्यद्य य इमे मद्वधोद्यताः॥
en: Wait for me, O charioteer, restraining the steeds for a moment only, until I slay these that are resolved to destroy me.

sa: त्रयाणामपि लोकानां पर्याप्ता इति मे मतिः। पाण्डवानां समस्ताश्च नातिष्ठन्त पराक्रमे॥
en: I consider these to be a match for the three world united together. The whole Pandava army can not withstand your prowess.

sa: गौरवं पाण्डुपुत्राणां मान्यान् मानयतां च तान्। दृष्ट्वा महीक्षितस्तत्र पूजयाञ्चक्रिरे भृशम्॥
en: Seeing the nobleness of the Pandavas, who had paid due honour to those that deserved it, all the kings highly praised them.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय वेगवत् परवीरहा। भगदत्तं रणे क्रुद्ध विव्याध निशितैः शरैः॥
en: Thereupon, that slayer of hostile heroes, taking up another bow of great toughness, pierced the enraged Bhagadatta with sharp shafts in battle.

sa: तं विनाशं मनुष्येन्द्र गरवारणवाजिनाम्। नामृष्यत तदा भीष्मः सैन्यघातं रणे परैः॥
en: Then, O foremost of men, Bhishma did not tolerate that slaughter of men, elepnants and steeds, of your host, by the enemy.

sa: संजय उवाच भगदत्तः कृपः शल्यः कृतवर्मा तथैव च। विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ सैन्धवश्च जयद्रथः॥ चित्रसेनो विकर्णश्च तथा दुर्मर्षणादयः।
en: Sanjaya said Having heard those words of the highsouled Drona, Bhagadatta, Kripa, Shalya, Kritvarma, the princes Vinda and Anuvinda from Avanti, Jayadratha the ruler of the Sindhus, Chitrasena, Vikarna and Durmarshana and others,

sa: एवं तदभवद् युद्ध दिवसं भरतर्षभ। पाण्डवानां कुरूणां च पुरस्कृत्य घटोत्कचम्॥
en: Thus, O foremost of the Bharata race, did the battle rage that day, between the Kurus and the Pandavas headed by Ghatotkacha.

sa: कौरवेषु निवृत्तेषु पाण्डवा जितकाशिनः। सिंहनादान् भृशं चक्रुः शङ्खान् दध्मुश्च भारत॥
en: Upon the withdrawal of the Kurus, the victorious Pandavas sent up their war cries accompanied with the blare of conchs and cornets.

sa: तथा तव परित्यागो न मे राजश्चिकीर्षितः। अप्येवं पाण्डव प्राणानुत्सृजेयमहं युधि॥
en: Rather, O son of Pandu, I would give up my life in battle, than be antagonistic to my preceplor, at any tiine.

sa: इन्द्रियाणां हि चरतां यन्मनोऽनु विधीयते। तदस्य हरति प्रज्ञां वायु वमिवाम्भसि॥
en: The understanding of that man is destroyed whose mind follows the roving senses, as the wind destroys a boat in a sea.

sa: न व्यूहो भिद्यते तत्र कौरवाणां कथंचन। रक्षितः सत्यसंधेन भारद्वाजेन संयुगे॥
en: O sire, O king, the Vyuha protected as it was by the son of Bharadvaja (Drona) could by no means be broken.

sa: व्यामिश्रेणेव वाक्येन बुद्धिं मोहयसीव मे। तेदकं वद निश्चित्य येन श्रेयोऽहमाप्नुयाम्॥
en: You confound my mind by equivocal words, (praising action once and praising knowledge next). Tell me definitely what is good for me".

sa: तं कदाचित् सुखासीनं ताभ्यां सह शुचिस्मिता। दुहिताभ्यागमत् कन्या सृञ्जयं वरवर्णिनी॥
en: One day when Srinjaya was seated with the sages at his ease, his very beautiful daughter of pure smiles came to him.

sa: देवान् भावयतानेन ते देवा भावयन्तु वः। परस्परं भावयन्तः श्रेयः परमवाप्स्यथ॥
en: Please the celestial by this (Sacrifice); may the celestial please you. Thus pleasing each other you will attain to the highest good".

sa: यस्य वीर्यं समाश्रित्य धार्तराष्ट्र विकत्यसे। हन्तास्मि प्रथमं भीष्मं मिषतां सर्वधन्विनाम्॥
en: Him depending on whose strength you are now boasting. I shall first slay that Bhishma within the sight of all bow men.

sa: शोणितैः सिच्यमानानि वस्त्राणि कवचानि च। छत्राणि च पताकाच सर्वं रक्तमदृश्यत॥
en: Their garments and coats of mail and umbrellas and standards being steeped in blood, everything in that battle appeared to be crimson.

sa: ततो रक्षो महाबाहुं सात्यकिं सत्यविक्रमम्। विव्याध विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैः सिंहनादं ननाद च।॥
en: Then the mighty-armed Rakshasa, O you uf prowess incapable of being baffled, pierced Satyaki with sharp arrows and uttered aloud his war-cry.

sa: ततः परेण कौरव्य जलधारो महागिरिः॥ ततो नित्यमुपादत्ते वासवः परमं जलम्।
en: O descendant of Kuru, the next is the large mountain, called Jaladhara. From it, Indra daily takes water of the best quality.

sa: स कर्म दुष्करं कृत्वा संग्रामे शत्रुतापनः। शत्रुभिर्निहतः संख्ये पृतनायां युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Having achieved many feats difficult of being achieved, that afflicter of foes, 0 Yudhisthira, was slain amidst this troops by his adversaries.

sa: अद्य ते दर्शयिष्यामि पूर्वप्रेतान् पितामहान्। एवं संजल्पतस्तस्य बीभत्सोः शत्रुघातिनः॥ श्रुत्वापि परुषं वाक्य सुशर्मा रथयूथपः। न चैनमब्रवीत् किंचिच्छुभं वा यदि वाऽशुभम्॥
en: Today I shall transport you to your grenadiers who had long being dwelling in the regions of the dead.” Hearing these insulting words spoken by that slayer of foes namely Vibhatsu, Susharma, the commander of a cardivision spoke nothing well or ill in reply.

sa: एवं द्वन्द्वसहस्राणि रथवारणवाजिनाम्। पदातीनं च समरे तव तेषां च संकुले॥
en: Thus in that great battle thousands of single combats were fought between car-warriors, elephants men, horse-men sand foot-soldiers of both the sides.

sa: ततः पुनरपि द्रोणो नाम विश्रावयन् युधि। अकरोद् रौद्रमात्मानं किरञ्छरशतैः परान्॥
en: And again did Drona, shouting forth his own name, made himself terrible in battle by piercing his enemies with hundreds of arrows.

sa: सहदेवोऽपि नृपते इदमाह वचोऽर्थवत्। सुयोधन मतिर्या ते वृथैषा ते भविष्यति॥
en: Sahadeva too, O ruler of men, said these words pregnant with meaning. “O Suyodhana, the hopes entertained by you will be vain.

sa: स्तुवतां नाद्य श्रूयन्ते पुत्राणां शिबिरे मम। सूतमागधसंघानां नर्तकानां च सर्वशः॥
en: In the encampment of my sons, the sounds of numerous minstrels and panegyrists singing eulogies and of dancers, are no longer heard.

sa: अवप्लुत्याथ पाञ्चाल्यो रथात् तूर्णं महाबलः। आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं सात्यकेस्तु महात्मनः॥
en: Thereupon that mighty car-warrior the Panchala prince quickly jumping down his car, ascended with agility the chariot of the highly illustrious Satyaki.

sa: युध्यतां तु तेषां कुर्वतां कर्म दुष्करम्। अस्तं गिरिमथारूढे अप्रकाशति भास्करे॥
en: When they thus fought on achieving feats difficult of being accomplished, the sun being lost to the sight ascended the western hills,

sa: निकृत्य रथिनां चाजौ रथेषाश्च युगानि च॥ जघान रथिनश्चापि बलवान् रिपुमर्दनः।
en: That mighty chastiser of foes, cut off the shafts and yokes of those warriors on their cars, and he then killed them.

sa: एवमेतं महाव्यूहं व्यूह्य भारत पाण्डवाः। अतिष्ठन् समरे शूरा योद्धुकामा जयैषिणः॥
en: Thus, O Bharata, forming this mighty array, the heroic sons of Pandu occupied the fled anxiously longing for battle and for victory.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य त्रैगर्तः प्रस्थलाधिपः। अभिद्रुत्य रणे भीममर्जुनं चैव धन्विनौ॥
en: Hearing these words of the king, the chief of the Trigarta's, the ruler of Prasthala, assaulting the two bowmen Bhima and Arjuna,

sa: युधिष्ठिरो यत्र सैन्ये स्वयमेव बलार्णवे। तत्र ते पृथिवीपाला भूयिष्ठं पर्यवस्थिताः॥
en: And in that part of that ocean of forces, where Yudhishthira himself (was), stationed a large number of rulers of the earth.

sa: ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये। मत्त एवेति तान् विद्धि न त्वह तेषु ते मयि॥
en: And all existing things of Sattva, Raja and Tama Gunas (the qualities of goodness of passion and of darkness), are all from Me. I am, however, not in them; they are in Me.

sa: स सत्यसंगतो भूत्वा ममेदमिति निश्चितः। कुरूणां पालय बलं यथा दुर्योधनस्तथा॥
en: Therefore being faithfully united with the Kurus and believing their army to be your own, do you, like Duryodhana himself, protect it."

sa: गजेनाक्षिप्य बलिना रथः संचूर्णितः क्षितौ। रथिना ताडितो नागो नाराचेनापतत् क्षितौ॥
en: Chariots, dashed against the earth by powerful elephants, became splintered into pieces. Wounded severely by elephants, steeds fell down with their riders.

sa: स्वागतं धर्मपुत्राय भीमाय यमयोस्तथा। किं वा कार्यं करोम्यद्य युष्माकं प्रीतिवर्धनम्॥
en: Welcome to the son of Dharma and also to Bhima and the twins. What act enhancing your delight shall I do now?

sa: खुरशब्देन चाश्वानां नेमिघोषेण तेन च। तेन चोत्कृष्टशब्देन ज्यानिनादेन तेन च॥
en: In consequence of the clatter of horse hoofs, the rattle of car-wheels, the he cries cries of combatants, the twang of bowstrings.

sa: आपस्ततोऽन्यो विज्ञेयाः शेषः संक्षेप उच्यते। ततोऽन्य उच्यते चायमेनं संक्षेपतः शृणु॥
en: Beside these portions, the rest is all water. I shall describe them to you shortly. Hear what I now describe in brief.

sa: सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः। नमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते॥
en: Always glorifying Me, exerting themselves with firm vows, bowing down to Me with reverence, being always devoted to Me they worship Me.

sa: भावा न तास्तर्केण साधयेत्। प्रकृतिभ्यः परं यत् तु तदचिन्त्यस्य लक्षणम्॥
en: Those matters that are inconceivable can never be solved by reason. What is above nature is an indication that it is inconceivable.

sa: ते यत्ता भीमसेनेन सहिताः काञ्चनध्वजाः। प्रत्यदृश्यन्त राजेन्द्र सेन्द्रा इव दिवौकसः॥
en: All of them possessing golden standards, full of energy and accompanied by Bhimasena, appeared, O monarch, like the celestials, headed by Indra.

sa: पुनः कर्णं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्। ततो दुर्योधनो द्रोणो राजा चैव जयद्रथः॥
en: Thereupon king Duryodhana, Drona and Jayadratha, with a combined effort, rescued Radha's son who had been sinking in the ocean of Satyaki.

sa: शृणु राजन्नेकमना वचनं ब्रुवतो मम। यत् ते पुत्रास्तदाऽकार्युर्हते देवव्रते मृधे॥
en: Hear, O monarch, with singleness of mind, the words, falling from my lips, regarding what your sons did when Devavrata had fallen.

sa: संजय उवाच देवव्रते तु निहते कुरूणामृषभे तदा। किमकार्ष पतयस्तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: Sanjaya said Therefore, O Sanjaya, recount to me what the kings did, when Devarata, the foremost of the Kurus, had been slain.

sa: तस्मिन् विनिहते शूरे दुराधर्षे महात्मनि। किं नु स्वित् कुरोऽकार्पुर्निमग्नाः शोकसागरे॥
en: When that unconquerable and high-souled hero was slain, what, for sooth, did the Kurus, deep down into the sea of sorrow, do?

sa: मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम्। कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक् च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा।।३४।
en: I am the Source of all that is to be. Among females, I am Fame, Fortune, Speech, Memory, Intellect, Courage, and Forgiveness.

sa: गुरुवात्सल्यमत्यन्तं नैभृत्यं विनयो दमः। नकुलेऽप्रातिरूप्यं च शौर्ये च नियतानि षट्॥
en: Devotion to the elders, secrecy of counsels, modesty, self-control, beauty of person and heroism, these six virtues are ever present in Nakula.

sa: तत उद्धर्षयन् सर्वान् दृष्टद्युम्नोऽभ्यभाषत॥ अहं द्रोणान्तकः पार्थ विहितः शम्भुना पुरा।
en: Then giving delight to all who heard him, Dhrishtadyumna thus spoke; “O son of Pritha, I am the ordained slayer of Drona."

sa: भोजस्तु प्रहसन् पार्थे वासुदेवं च माधवम्। एकैकं पञ्चविंशत्या सायकान समार्पयत्॥
en: Thereupon the king of the Bhojas smilingly pierced Pritha's son and Vasudeva of Madhus race, each with a group of twenty-five arrows.

sa: द्रोणं दुर्योधनं शल्यमश्वत्थामानमेव च। प्रायशश्च महेष्वासा ये प्रधानाः स्म कौरवाः॥
en: Drona, Duryodhana, Shalya Ashvathama, and other foremost bowmen of the Kaurava host were seen to fly away from the field of battle.

sa: यथा शाल्वपते नान्यं वरं व्यामि कथंचन। त्वामृते पुरुषव्याघ्र तथा मूर्धानमालभे॥
en: I do not, O lord of the Shalvas, desire any husband save yourself, O foremost among men, I swear by my heart.

sa: नैव ते श्रद्दधुर्मीता वदतोरावयोर्वचः। तांश्च प्रद्रवतो दृष्ट्वा जयं प्राप्ताश्च पाण्डवाः॥
en: They also did not believe the words we uttered, as they were inspired with terror. Beholding them fly, the Pandavas winning victory.

sa: कथयामास दुर्धर्षो विनिःश्वस्य पुनः पुनः। अब्रवीच्च तदा राजन् भीष्मं कुरुपिताहम्॥
en: the won That invincible warrior, O king, theli spoke these words, sighing repeatedly and addressing the grandsire of the Kurus namely Bhishma.

sa: दृष्टं दुर्योधनैतत् ते यथा पार्थेन धीमता। जलस्य धारा जनिता शीतस्यामृतगन्धिनः॥
en: You have seen, even now, O Duryodhana, how the intelligent Partha created that jet of water, cool and fraught with nectarious fragrance.

sa: अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दक्ष उदासीनो गतव्यथः। सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः॥
en: He is dear to Me who is pure, diligent, unconcerned, and free from all distress, and desireless for the fruits of actions.

sa: अर्जुनेन प्रतिज्ञाते पाञ्चजन्यं जनार्दनः। प्रदध्मौ तत्रं संकुद्धो देवदत्तं च फाल्गुनः॥
en: When Arjuna had thus taken that oath Janardana blew the conch Panchajanya and Phalguna also excited with rage blew his conch Devadatta.

sa: तं तु श्रुत्वा महानादं प्रहृष्टानां महात्मनाम्। नामृष्यत महेष्वासो भगदत्तः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Hearing the roars of the delighted Pandavas of high soul, the highly powerful Bhagadatta that fierce bowman was unable to brook them.

sa: एतं हि पुरुषव्याघ्र धनुष्मन्तं महाबलम्। दृष्ट्वा विप्रद्रुतं सैन्यं समरे मार्गणाहतम्॥
en: Seeing that foremost of men, that great warrior, armed with bow, my troops afflicted with his arrows, fly away (in all directions).

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा भवानत्र प्राप्तकालं व्यवस्यताम्। यथा लोकः समुच्छेदं नायं गच्छेत भारत॥
en: Having heard all this, O descendant of Bharata, do what is proper, so that the world may not meet with extermination. are

sa: ततः प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा रथेन रथिनां वरः। शयानं भरतश्रेष्ठं सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम्॥
en: Thereafter that foremost of car-warriors (Arjuna) circumambulating that prostrate chief of the Bharatas, that foremost of all wielders of weapons, viz., Bhishma,

sa: कृष्ण पश्य महेष्वासं भीष्मं भीमपराक्रमम्। शरैर्दहन्तं सैन्यं मे चीष्मे कक्षमिवानलम्॥
en: O Krishna, behold the greatly powerful and mighty bowman Bhishma. He consumes my troops with his arrows as fire consumes dry grass.

sa: काञ्चनं यद्यदस्यासीद् वर्म चाभरणानि च। धनुषश्च शराणां च तदपश्याम केवलम्॥
en: His golden coat of mail and his buckler and his ornaments and his arrows and bow only were seen by us then.

sa: उपद्रष्टानुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः। परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन् पुरुषः परः॥
en: The supreme Purusha in then (human) body is the surveyor, adviser, supporter, and enjoyer; he is the mighty Lord and Supreme Self.

sa: अयं चापि महेष्वासः पार्षतो वाहिनीपतिः। भीमसेनश्च समरे पालयिष्यति वो ध्रुवम्॥
en: This fierce bowman the son of Prishata the commander of our hosts and Bhimasena also, will assuredly protect you all in battle.

sa: उपधानं ततो दत्त्वा पितुस्ते मनुजेश्वराः॥ सहिताः पाण्डवाः सर्वे कुरवश्च महारथाः।
en: Then having offered that pillow of your sire, all those kings, together with the mighty car-warriors of the Kurus and the Pandavas,

sa: गच्छ मद्वचनाद् रामं जामदग्न्यं तपस्विनम्। रामस्ते सुमहद् दुःखं शोकं चैवापनेष्यति॥
en: By my advice go to the ascetic Rama, the son of Jamadagni. Rama will remove this heavy and horrible grief of yours.

sa: ततस्तु तावकाः शूराः पुरस्कृत्य महाव्रतम्। शिखण्डिप्रमुखान् पार्थान् योधयन्ति स्म संयुगे॥
en: Then all your warriors placing before them Bhishma of regulated vows began to fight with the Partha's having Shikhandin at their van.

sa: स्त्रियः काश्चित्प्रजायन्ते चतस्रः पञ्चकन्यकाः। जातमात्राश्च नृत्यन्ति गायन्ति च हसन्ति च॥
en: Women give birth to four or five daughters all at a time, and these, as soon as born, dance, sing, and laugh.

sa: प्रययौ समरे तूर्णं तव पुत्रस्य शासनात्। नर्दमानो महानादं प्रावृषीव बलाहकः॥
en: Complying with the commands of your son, speedily rushed to battle uttering deafening roars like those of clouds in the rainy season.

sa: तं भीष्मेण नरव्याघ्र तथा विनिहतं युधि॥ प्रपतन्तमपश्याम गिरेः शृङ्गमिव च्युतम्।
en: When he was thus killed by Bhishma in that battle, we saw him fall down like a loosened peak of a mountain.

sa: उदतिष्ठद् रजो भौमं न प्राज्ञायत किंचन। अस्तगत इवादित्ये सैन्येन सहसाऽऽवृते॥
en: A fearful dust arose and every thing became invisible. The sun, becoming suddenly shrouded by it appeared as if it had set.

sa: यथा सिंहस्य नदतः स्वनं श्रुत्वेतरे मृगाः। त्रसेयुर्निनदं श्रुत्वा तथाऽसीदत तद्बलम्॥
en: As animals are afflicted with fear in hearing the voice of the roaring lion, so were that force on hearing those sounds.

sa: पृथिव्यां सहवासोऽभूद्रामे राज्यं प्रशासति। नाहीयत तदा प्राणः प्राणिनां न तदन्यथा॥
en: Lived on the face of the earth, when Rama ruled over the kingdom. Then the lives of animate beings never terminated untimely.

sa: त्वष्ट्रा पुरा तपस्तप्त्वा वर्षायुतशतं तदा। वृत्रो विनिर्मितो देवाः प्राप्यानुज्ञां महेश्वरात्॥
en: In days gone by, observing ascetic austerities for millions of years, Tvashtri created, O Gods, Vritra, having obtained permission thereto from Mahadeva.

sa: दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनं हृष्टाः पञ्चाला युद्धनन्दिनः। दध्मुः प्रीता महाशवान् भेर्यश्च मधुरस्वनाः॥
en: Seeing the Duryodhana, the Panchalas, who ever liked fighting, were filled with delight, They blew their loud-sounding conchs and sweet sounding cymbals.

sa: विरथांश्च महेष्वासान् कृत्वा तत्र स राक्षसः। अभिदुद्राव वेगेन हन्तुकामो निशाचरः॥
en: Then that Rakshasas that ranger of the nights, depriving those mighty champions of their cars, rushed against them desirous of slaying them.

sa: इत्यासीत् तुमुल: शब्दो राजन् भीष्मरथं प्रति॥ निहत्य समरे राजशतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।
en: Such were the cries, O king, that were then heard round Bhishma's chariot. Bhishma then slaughtered his foes by hundreds and thousands.

sa: ततः श्वेतैर्हयैर्युक्ते महति स्यन्दने स्थितौ। माधवः पाण्डवश्चैव दिव्यौ शङ्खौ प्रदध्मतुः॥
en: Then Madhava (Srikrishna) and the son of Pandu (Arjuna), seated in a great car yoked with white steeds, blew their celestial conchs.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच द्वैधीभवति मे चित्तं ह्रिया तुष्ट्या च संजय। मम पुत्रस्य यत् सैन्यं सौभद्रः समावारयत्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Upon hearing that Subhadra's son, singleheaded as he was, held in bay the entire army of my son, my heart, my heart, O Sanjaya, is simultaneously filled with shame and delight.

sa: तेषां समागमो घोरो बभूव युधि संगतः। अन्योन्यस्य वधार्थाय जीगीषूणां महाहवे॥
en: Then dreadful was the encounter in that battle between those two armies, each desirous of slaughtering and gaining victory over its rival.

sa: यो मामेवमसम्मूढो जानाति पुरुषोत्तमम्। स सर्वविद् भजति मां सर्वभावेन भारत॥
en: He, who without being deluded, knows Me to be this Highest Being, O Bharata, knowing all this, worships Me with all thoughts.

sa: दर्शयेम च रूपाणि स्वशरीरे बहून्यपि। न तु पर्यायतः सिद्धिर्बुद्धिमाप्नोति मानुषीम्॥
en: In this body of mine I can show many forms but it is not by inspiring fight that a man becomes successful.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो दृष्ट्वा युद्धाय समवस्थिते। ते सेने सागरप्रख्ये मुहुः प्रचलिते नृप॥ विमुच्य कवचं वीरो निक्षिष्य च वरायुधम्। अवरुह्य रथात् क्षिप्रं पद्भ्यामेव कृताञ्जलिः॥ पितामहमभिप्रेक्ष्य धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। वाग्यतः प्रययौ येन प्राङ्मुखो रिपुवाहिनीम्॥
en: O king, seeing the two armies, which resembled two oceans, ready for the battle and marching continually forward, the brave king Yudhishthira, Dharmaraja, put off his Armour and cast aside his excellent weapons. Then soon alighting from his chariot, he proceeded with joined hands, and with restrained speech towards the direction where the hostile host stood loO king at the grand father and facing the east.

sa: शैनेयं स तु निर्भिद्य प्राविशद् धरणीतलम्। वसन्तकाले बलवान् बिलं सर्पशिशुर्यथा॥
en: That Naracha penetrating Shini's grandson, entered the surface of the earth like a powerful young snake entering its hold in the spring.

sa: स मां नियुक्ष्व राजेन्द्र यथा योद्धा भवाम्हम्। प्रतिज्ञातमुपप्लव्ये यत् तत् पार्थेन पूर्ततः॥ घातयिष्यामि गाङ्गेयमिति लोकस्य संनिधौ। परिरक्ष्यमिदं तावद् वचः पार्थस्य धीमतः॥
en: So, O most excellent king, command me so that I may fight for you. The vow that formerly Partha took at Upaplavya saying 'I will slay the son of Ganga' before the presence of all creatures, even that vow of intelligent Partha should be kept inviolate.

sa: विव्याध चैनं सप्तत्या नाराचानां महाबलः। हताश्वं रथमुत्सृज्य स तु राजा श्रुतायुधः॥ अभ्यद्रवद् रणे पार्थे गदामुद्यम्य वीर्यवान्। वरुणस्यात्मजो वीरः स तु राजा श्रुतायुधः॥ पर्णाशा जननी यस्य शीततोया महानदी। तस्य माताब्रवीद् राजन् वरुणं पुत्रकारणात्॥
en: And that highly puissant hero also pierced him with seventy Narachas. Thereupon leaving his chariot of which the steeds were slain, king Shrutayusha endued with great energy rushed againsi Pritha's son, heaving his huge mace over his head. The heroic king Shrutayusha and the son of Varuna having for his mother the mighty river of cool waters called Parnasa. O king, her mother, for the benefit of her son, had

sa: कदा वाहेयिका गाथा: पुनर्गास्यामि शाकले।॥ गव्यस्य तृप्ता मांसस्य पीत्वा गौडं सुरासवम्। गौरीभिः सह नारीभिहतीभिः स्वलंकृताः॥ पलाण्डुगंडूषयुतान् खादन्ती चैडकान् बहून्। वाराहं कौक्कुटं मांसं गव्यं गार्दभमौष्ट्रिकम्॥ ऐडं च ये न खादन्ति तेषां जन्म निरर्थकम्।
en: When shall I next sing the songs of the Bahikas in this town of Shakala having fed me full with beef and drunk the Gada liquor. Decked with ornaments when shall I with these huge women and maidens feed upon a large number of sheep, a quantity of pork and beef and the meat of fowls, asses and camels. In vain do they live who do not eat the sheep.

sa: न चेत् तदभिमन्येत पुरुषोऽर्जुनदर्शिवान्॥ तस्मै दद्यां शतं नागाशतं ग्रामाञ्शतं रथान्। सुवर्णस्य च मुख्यस्य हयाग्र्याणां शतं शतान्॥ ऋद्धया गुणैः सुदान्तांश्च धुर्यवाहान् सुशिक्षितान्।
en: If the person, who will point out Arjuna, be not contented with it I shall give him a hundred clephants, a hundred villages, a hundred golden cars, ten thousand horses of most superior breed, fat, docile, gifted with other qualities, capable of dragging cars and well-trained.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच तस्माद् भवाशीघ्रमितः प्रयातु राज्ञः प्रवृत्यै कुरुसत्तमस्य। नूनं स विद्धोनऽतिभृशं पृषत्कैः कर्णेन राजा शिबिरं गतोऽसौ॥
en: Arjuna said For this very reason proceed you quickly from here and bring the news of the king, that foremost of Kurus. Forsooth, greatly wounded with Karna's arrows the king has gone to his camp.

sa: सायकेविधैस्तीक्ष्णैःकङ्कपत्रैः शिलाशितैः। भल्लैरनेकैर्विविधैः शक्त्यृष्टिमुसलैरपि॥ यत्र यत्र स धर्मात्मा दुष्टां दृष्टिं व्यसर्जयत्। तत्र तत्र व्यशीर्यन्त तावका भरतर्षभ॥
en: While they were being slain by Dharma's son with various sharp Kanka-feathered arrows whetted on stone, Bhallas, Saktis and clubs. Wherever the virtuous king extended his looks all the soldiers of your party were shattered.

sa: पलायध्वं कुरवो नैतदस्ति सेन्द्रा देवा घनन्ति नः पाण्डवार्थे। तथा तेषां मजतां भारतानां तस्मिन् द्वीपः सूतपुत्रो बभूव॥
en: "Fly, O Kouravas, all is lost. The gods with Indra at their head are slaying us for the sake of the Pandavas.” At that time there was nobody that could save the sinking Bharata troops."

sa: सुकेशं धार्मिकं दृष्ट्वा वरलब्धं च राक्षसम्। ग्रामणी म गन्धर्वो विश्वावसुसमप्रभः॥ तस्य देववती नाम द्वितीया श्रीरिवात्मजा। त्रिषु लोकेषु विख्याता रूपयौवनशालिनी॥ तां सुकेशाय धर्मात्मा ददौ रक्षः श्रियं यथा।
