en: Cveing Sukeśa righteous and furnished with the boon, a virtuous Gandharva, named Grāmani, of the effulgence of fire, who had a daughter, called Devavati, like to a second Sri herself, famed over the three worlds, and endowed with beauty and youth, bestowed her on Sukeśa as if he had bestowed the goddess of fortune of the Rākşasa.

sa: एष प्राप्तो दशग्रीवो मम भ्राता महाबलः॥ सुरलोकजयाकाङ्क्षी साहाय्ये त्वां वृणोति च। तदस्य त्वं सहायार्थं सबन्धुर्गच्छ राक्षस॥
en: Here is my brother, the highly power Dasagrīva. Being desirous of conquering the region of the celestials he prays for your help. Do you therefore proceed to his help, O Raksasa, with all they friends.

sa: गजेन्द्राक्रीडमथिता नदीवाकुलतां गता। लुलिताकुलकेशान्ता करवेपितपल्लवा।॥ पवनेनावधूतेव लता कुसुमशालिनी। सा वेपमाना लज्जन्ती भीता करकृताञ्जलिः॥ नलकूबरमासाद्य पादयोनिपपात ह।
en: Her hairs were dishevelled and her hands were trembling. Like to a blossoming creeper shaken by the wind, she, trembling and bashful and with folded hands, went to Nalakubara and fell down at his feet.

sa: राक्षसैः सा परित्यक्ता पुरा विष्णुभयार्दितैः॥ शून्या रक्षोगणैः सर्वै रसातलतलं गतः। शून्या संप्रति लङ्का सा प्रभुस्तस्या न विद्यते॥ स त्वं तत्र निवासाय गच्छ पुत्र यथासुखम्। निर्दोषस्तत्र ते वासो न बाधस्तत्र कस्यचित् ॥
en: Formerly she was renounced by the Raksasas afflicted with the fear of Vişnu; and was empty of swarms of Rākşasa, who had gone to the nethermost regions. Now Lanka is vacant, and there is no one that lords it over her. Do you, my child, for abode, at your ease repair thither. Your stay there shall meet with no rub, and no manner of disturbance shall occur there.

sa: रावणस्य रथं क्षिप्रं चोदयामास सारथिः। तमापतन्तं सहसा स्वनवन्तं महाध्वजम्॥ रथं राक्षसराजस्य नरराजो ददर्श ह। कृष्णवाजिसमायुक्तं युक्तं रौद्रेण वर्चसा॥ दीप्यमानमिवाकाशे विमानं सूर्यवर्चसम्। तडित्पताकागहनं दर्शितेन्द्रायुधप्रभम्॥ शरधारा विमुञ्चन्तं धाराधरमिवाम्बुदम्।
en: And as it speedily descended, the monarch of men beheld that Raksasa-king's resounding car, having huge standards, yoked with black chargers, and endowed with fierce splendour; as if flaming in the firmament; having the resplendance of the Sun himself; with thronging lightning pennons; displaying the glow of Indra's weapon* showering arms; and resembling rain-charged clouds. *The rain-blow.

sa: समुद्रं लवयित्वा तु घोरं नदनदीपतिम्। गतिं हनूगतो लोके को विद्यात्तर्कयेत वा॥ बलान्यपरिमेयानि वीर्याणि च निशाचराः। परेषां सहावज्ञा न कर्तव्या कथंचन ॥
en: Who had in this world ever thought of or reasoned at ɔut Hanuman's career over the dreadful deep, the lord of streams and rivers? O rangers of the night, the strength and prowess (of the foe) being immeasurable, you should by no means recklessly disregard him.

sa: ततः सुकेशो वरदानगर्वितः श्रियं प्रभोः प्राप्य हरस्य पार्श्वतः। चचार सर्वत्र महान्महामतिः खगं पुरं प्राप्य पुरंदरो यथा।॥
en: Then the great and magnanimous Sukeśa, puffed up with the receipt of boons, having obtained auspiciousness at the hands of the lord, Hara, began to range everywhere, even as Purandara did on having obtained heaven.

sa: देव्या दग्धं प्रभावेण यच्च सव्यं तवेक्षणम्। पैङ्गल्यं यदवाप्तं हि देव्या रूपनिरीक्षणात्॥ एकाक्षिपिङ्गलीत्येव नाम स्थास्यति शाश्वतम्। एवं तेन सखित्वं च प्राप्यानुज्ञां च शंकरात्॥ आगतेन मया चैवं श्रुतस्ते पापनिश्चयः।
en: This your left eye has been burnt through the energy of the goddess, and has turned tawny in consequence of having seen the grace of the goddess; your shall be Ekāksipingala. Then at Saikara's command I sinless one, SO name ever have obtained the privilege of companionship (with him). Having come here I have heard of your evil designs.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा स गतो ब्रह्मा स्वस्थानं त्रिदशैः सह। गतेषु ब्रह्मपूर्वेषु देवेष्वथ नभस्तलम्॥ धनेशः पितरं प्राह प्राञ्जलिः प्रयतात्मवान्। भगवल्लब्धवानस्मि वरमिष्टं पितामहात्॥ निवासनं न मे देवो विदधे स प्रजापतिः। तं पश्य भगवन्कंचिनिवासं साधु मे प्रभो। न च पीडा भवेद्यत्र प्राणिनो यस्य कस्यचित्।।२३ एवमुक्तस्तु पुत्रेण विश्रवा मुनिपुङ्गवः। वचनं प्राह धर्मज्ञ श्रूयतामिति सत्तम॥
en: Having said this, Brahmă along with the celestials went to his own quarters. On the deities with Brahmã at their head, having departed foe the heavenly regions, the selfpossessed lord of wealth of subdued senses with joined hands spoke to his sire, saying, 'o reverend one, I have received the wished-for boon from the great-father, but the exalted lord of creatures has not fixed any abode for me. Therefore, O lord, do you seek out some dwelling for me, where no creature whatever can come by misfortune. Thus accosted by his son, that best of ascetics, Viśravä, spoke, O righteous one,' Listen! O excellent one.

sa: स प्रभावेण शूलस्य दौरात्म्येनात्मनस्तथा। संतापयति लोकांस्त्रीन्विशेषेण च तापसान्॥ एवंप्रभावो लवणः शूलं चैव तथाविधम्। श्रुत्वा प्रमाणं काकुत्स्थ त्वं हि नः परमा गतिः॥
en: And by virtue of the power of the dart, he oppress the three worlds in especial the ascetics; such is the power of Lavaņa, and such is his dart. Hearing all this O Kākutstha, you are capable (of righting our wrong.) You are our chief resource.

sa: अतीवासुखभोगी स सततं कुन्तिनन्दनः। न हि पश्यामि बीभत्सोर्निन्द्यं गात्रेषु किंचन। श्रोतव्यं चेन्मयै तद् वै तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: That son of Kunti has to bear a large share of misery. I do not see any censurable mark in his body. You should explain the cause to me if I deserve to hear it.

sa: मम दयिततमा हृता वनाद् रजनिचरेण विमथ्य येन सा। कथय मम रिपुं तमद्य वै प्लवगपते यमसंनिधिं नयामि॥
en: Tell me all about that ranger of the night, that deceitfully has carried away my dearest wife from the forest. My foe, O lord of monkey will I to-day send to the neighbourhood of Yāma.

sa: परिवेषी यथा सोमः परिपूर्णो विराजते॥ स रराज तथा संख्ये दर्शनीयो नरोत्तमः। निर्विशेषो महाराज यथा हि विजयस्तथा।॥
en: O monarch, that foremost of men, was looking, during that fight, so beautiful, like the full Moon in the midst of his corona. He look like Arjuna. There is no difference between him and Arjuna.

sa: अघोषयंश्च नगरे वचनादाहुकस्य ते॥ जनार्दनस्य रामस्य बभ्रोश्चैव महात्मनः। अद्यप्रभृति सर्वेषु वृष्ण्यन्धककुलेष्विह॥ सुरासवो न कर्तव्यः सर्वैर्नगरवासिभिः। यश्च नोऽविदितं कुर्यात् पेयं कश्चिन्नरः क्वचित्॥ जीवन् स शूलमारोहेत् स्वयं कृत्वा सबान्धवः।
en: At the command of Ahuka, of Janardana, of Rama, and of great Vabhru, it was, again, proclaimed throughout the city, that from that day, among all the Vrishnis and the Andhakas one should manufacture wines and intoxicating liquors of any kind, and that whoever would secretly manufacture wines no and spirits should be impaled alive with all his kinsmen.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच यदिदं भारतं वर्षं यत्रेदं मूर्च्छितं बलम्। यत्रातिमात्रलुब्धोऽयं पुत्रो दुर्योधनो मम॥ यत्र गृद्धाः पाण्डुपुत्रा यत्र मे सज्जते मनः। एतन्मे तत्त्वमाचक्ष्व त्वं हि मे बुद्धिमान् मतः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Tell me about the Varsha called Bharata in which these foolish men have assembled (to fight), for which my son Duryodhana has become so very covetous, which the Pandavas also are desirous of obtaining and in which even my mind sinks. Tell me all this, for you are, in my opinion endued with great intelligence.

sa: संनद्धमनुगच्छन्तं दृष्टवा भीमं स सात्यकिः। अभिनन्द्याब्रवीद् वीरस्तदा हर्षकरं वचः॥ त्वं भीम रक्ष राजानमेतत् कार्यतमं हि ते। अहं भित्त्वा प्रवक्ष्यामि कालपक्वमिदं बलम्॥
en: The heroic Satyaki saluting him said these delightful words. Then Satyaki with his person filled with delight, spoke these very words addressing Bhima-"O Bhima, do you protect the king, even this is your duty. I will proceed along penetrating through this host whose hour has come;

sa: विकारि तेषां राजेन्द्र सुदुष्करकरं मनः। ये पापानि न कुर्वन्ति मनोवाक्कर्मबुद्धिभिः। ते तपन्ति महात्मानो न शरीरस्य शोषणम्॥
en: These high-souled, men who do not commit sin in word, in deed, in heart or in soul, are said (really) to perform asceticism; but not those who make their bodies emaciated by fasts and penances.

sa: ऋषयः समेताः पश्चिमे वै प्रभासे समागता मन्त्रममन्त्रयन्त। चराम सर्वां पृथिवीं पुण्यतीर्थो तन्नः कामं हन्त गच्छाम सर्वे॥
en: Once upon a time, the Rishis, having assembled together, proceeded to the western Prabhasa. They held a consultation there which resulted in a determination on their part to sojourn to all sacred waters on Earth.

sa: संवर्त उवाच स्वागतं ते पुरुहूतेह विद्वन् यज्ञोऽप्ययं संनिहिते त्वयीन्द्र। शोशुभ्यते बलवृत्रघ्न भूयः पिबस्व सोमं सुतमुद्यतं मया।॥
en: Welcome to you, O Indra, by your presence here, I learned one, this sacrifice has been made grand, O destroyer of Vala, and Vritra, do you, again, drink this Soma juice produced by me today.

sa: आनुशंस्यपरो राजा प्रीयमाणो युधिष्ठिरः। उवाच स तदा भ्रातृनमात्यांश्च महीपतिः॥ मया चैव भवद्भिश्च मान्य एष नराधिपः। निदेशे धृतराष्ट्रस्य यस्तिष्ठति स मे सुहृत्॥
en: Shorn of malice as king Yudhishthira was, he was always affectionate towards his uncle. Addressing his brothers and ministers, the king said, 'King Dhritarashtra should be honoured both by myself and you all. He, indeed, is a well-wisher of mine who obeys the commands of Dhritarasthra,

sa: तथा कृष्णा द्रौपदी सात्वती च बालापत्या चोत्तरा कौरवी च। चित्राङ्गदा याश्च काश्चिस्त्रियोऽन्याः सार्धं राज्ञा प्रस्थितास्ता वधूभिः॥
en: Drupada's daughter Krishna, she of the Salvata race, Uttara the daughter-in-law of the Kauravas, who had recently become a mother. . Chitrangada, and other ladies attached to the royal house, all followed the old king.

sa: श्रोत्रं त्वक् चक्षुषी जिह्वा घ्राणमेव च पञ्चमम्। वाक् च हस्तौ च पादौ च पायुर्मेदूं तथैव च॥
en: This comprises the ear, the skin, the eyes, the tongue, and the nose forming the fifth, and speech, and the two hands, and the two legs, and the lower canal, and the organs of generation.

sa: नारद उवाच यस्ते पुत्रो गमितोऽयं विजातः स्वर्णष्ठीवी यमदात् पर्वतस्ते। पुनस्तु ते पुत्रमहं ददामि हिरण्यनाभं वर्षसहस्त्रिणं च॥
en: Narada said: I will give back to you that son of yours named Suvarnashthivin, whom Parvata gave you and who has been deprived of life! Effulgent like gold, that child shall live a thousand years.

sa: स कदाचित् समुद्रान्ते वसन् द्वारवतीमनु। एक एकं समागम्य मामुवाच हसन्निव॥ यत् तदुग्रं तपः कृष्ण चरन् सत्यपराक्रमः। अगस्त्याद् भारतचार्यः प्रत्यपद्यत मे पिता॥ अस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरो नाम देवगन्धर्वपूजितम्। तदद्य मयि दाशार्ह यथा पितरि मे तथा॥
en: One day, after he had settled in Dwaraka, he came to me, alone when I mysclf was also alone on the sea-coast, and there smilingly said, O Krishna, that weapon, called Brahmashira adored of gods and Gandharvas, which my father the preceptor of the Bharatas, having prowess capable of being baffled, had obtained from Agastya after practising the severest penances, is now with me, as it is with my father.

sa: सम्यग् वेदान् प्राप्य शास्त्राण्यधीत्य सम्यग् राज्यं पालयित्वा च राजा। चातुर्वर्ण्य स्थापयित्वा स्वधर्म पूतात्मा वै मोदते देवलोके॥
en: Having studied all the Vedas and the other scriptures duly, having protected the kingdom duly, and having made all the four orders follow their respective duties, a king become purified and finally sports in heaven.

sa: नर्दमानान् परान् दृष्ट्वा स्वबलस्य संक्षयम्॥ तथा दृष्ट्वा महाराज एकः स पृथिवीपतिः। हतं स्वहयमुत्सृज्य प्राङ्मुखः प्राद्रवद् भयात्॥
en: Seeing his enemies roaring aloud and the destruction of his own army, that lord of earth Duryodhana, without a comrade, left off his seven slain horse and fled from the field with face turned eastwards.

sa: मुक्तस्त्वयाहं त्वसमीक्ष्य कर्ण शिरो हृतं यन्न मयार्जुनस्य। समीक्ष्य मां मुञ्च रणे त्वमाशु हन्तास्मि शत्रु तव चात्मनश्च॥
en: O Karna, you discharged me without seeing me and hence I could not cut-off his head. Shoot me again immediately in battle after seeing me and I shall slay your enemies as well as mine.

sa: दुर्योधनो हतो यत्र शल्यश्च निहतो युधि॥ दुःशासनो विविंशश्च विकर्णश्च महाबलः। कथं हि भीमसेनस्य श्रोष्येऽहं शब्दमुत्तमम्॥ एकेन समरे येन हतं पुत्रशतं मम।
en: When Duryodhana has been slain, Shalya also has been slain in battle, when Dusshasana and Vivingsha and the mighty Vikarna have been slain, how shall I be able to bear the shouts of that Bhimasena who has alone killed a hundred sons of inine in battle?

sa: तान् प्रेक्ष्य द्रवतः सर्वान् भीमसेनभयार्दितान्। दुर्योधनस्तदा सूतमब्रवीद् विजयाय च॥ मामतिक्रमते पार्थो धनुष्याणिमवस्थितम्। जघने सर्वसैन्यानां ममाश्वान् प्रतिपादय॥
en: Beholding them all flying quickly in fear of Bhimasena, Duryodhana, if smiling, addressed his driver, saying-Partha, who is there with his bow, is going before me. Take my horses to the back of the army.

sa: निर्वेदो जीविते कृष्ण सर्वतश्चोपजायते। ये ह्येव धीरा ह्रीमन्त आर्याः करुणवेदिनः॥ त एव युद्धे हन्यन्ते यवीयान् मुच्यते जनः। हत्वाप्यनुशयो नित्यं परानपि जनार्दन॥
en: Lives on, O Krishna, as if in unconsciousness and his purposes are foiled at every step. Those who are modest, prudent, honourable, kind and wise are killed in battle; while a wicked avoids defeat. Even after killing the enemy we become a prey to repentance, OJanardana.

sa: यस्याः पुरःसरा आसन् पृष्ठतश्चानुगामिनः। साहमद्य सुदेष्णायाः पुरः पश्चाच्च गामिनी॥ इदं तु दुःखं कौन्तेय ममासा निबोध तत्।
en: Even she, who had number of dependents to walk both in van and rear, is now walking before and behind Sudeshna. O Kunti's son, listen to another grief of mine; it is unbearable to me.

sa: उत्तरा तु महार्हाणि विविधानि नवानि च। प्रतिगृह्याभवत् प्रीता तानि वासांसि भामिनी॥ मन्त्रयित्वा तु कौन्तेय उत्तरेण महात्मना। इतिकर्तव्यतां सर्वां राजन् पार्थे युधिष्ठिरे॥ ततस्तथा तद् व्यदधाद् यथावत् पुरुषर्षभ। सह पुत्रेण मत्स्यस्य प्रहृष्टा भरतर्षभाः॥
en: Uttara was exhilarated while receiving those various new and precious garments. O Janamejaya! Arjuna, the son of Kunti consulted the prince Uttara regarding revealing actual identity of Yudhishthira and decided duly all other affairs which were to be executed. O king! He then in a systematic manner, executed all affairs. Pandava, the greatest jewel to Bharata dynasty, exhilarated when all that arrangement was made in company of Uttara.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच युधिष्ठिरस्यासमहं पुरा सखा वैयाघ्रपद्यः पुनरस्मि विप्रः। अक्षान् प्रयोक्तुं कुशलोऽस्मि देविनां कङ्केति नाम्नास्मि विराट विश्रुतः॥
en: Yudhishthira said I was formerly a friend of Yudhishthira, I am a Brahmin belonging to the family named Vaiayghara, I am expert in casting dice. O Virata, I am known by the name of Kanka.

sa: न च पालयसे धर्मं लोकपालसमः कथम्। भ्रातरं राजराजानं महेश्वरसखं प्रभुम्॥ धनेश्वरं व्यपदिशन् कथं त्विह न लज्जसे।
en: Being equal to a Lokapala why have you no regard for virtue! Dishonouring that king, your adorable brother, the lord of wealth and friend of Maheshvara how it is that you do not feel shame"?

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच ततो निविशमानांस्तान् सैनिकान् रावणानुगाः। अभिजग्मुर्गणानेके पिशाचक्षुद्ररक्षसाम्॥ पर्वणः पतनो जम्भः खरः क्रोधवशो हरिः। प्ररुजश्चारुजश्चैव प्रघसश्चैवमादयः॥
en: Markandeya said : Then, when those troops were in their quarters, Parvana Patana, Jambha, Khara, Krodhavasha, Hari, Praruja, Aruja, Praghasa and many other minor Rakshasas and Pishachas under the sway of Ravana entered amongst them.

sa: एवमुक्तः स दुष्टात्मा प्राहसत् स्वनवत् तदा। अथ मां तत्र कैकेयी प्रेषयत् प्रणयेन तु॥ तेनैव देशिता पूर्वं भ्रातृप्रियचीकीर्पया। सुरामानय कल्याणि कीचकस्य निवेशनात्॥
en: Thus addressed, that wicked-souled Kichaka burst out into a loud laughter. Then Kaikeyi, out of affection for her brother, and previously urged by him and having a mind to do good to him, sent me to Kichaka saying, “O auspicious one, bring wine from Kichaka's house."

sa: वैनतेयसुतैः सूत षड्भिस्ततमिदं कुलम्। सुमुखेन सुनाम्ना च सुनेत्रेण सुवर्चसा॥ सुरुचा पक्षिराजेन सुबलेन च मातले। वर्धितानि प्रसृत्या वै विनताकुलकर्तृभिः॥ पक्षिराजाभिजात्यानां सहस्राणि शतानि च। कश्यपस्य ततो वंशे जातैर्भूतिविवर्धनैः॥
en: This species, O Suta, proceed from the six sons of Vainateya (Garuda)-Sumukha, Sunamana, Sunetra, Suvarchas and from the king of birds, Surucha and from Subala; O Matali, they have multiplied from the race of Vinata. Hundreds and thousands of birds, all of noble blood, have founded dynasties by means of begetting children in the race of Kashyapa.

sa: इति ब्रुवन् सारथिना दुःखितो भरतस्तदा॥ अयोध्यां सम्प्रविश्यैव विवेश वसतिं पितुः। तेन हीनां नरेन्द्रेण सिंहहीनां गुहामिव ॥
en: Having said this in grief, Bharata in company with the charioteer entered Ayodhyā and immediately went to the residence of his father, bereft of that foremost of men, like a cavern bereft of its lion.

sa: अलंकारं पुरस्यैवं कृत्वा तत् पुरवासिनः। आकाङ्क्षमाणा रामस्य यौवराज्याभिषेचनम्॥ समेत्य सङ्घशः सर्वे चत्वरेषु सभासु च। कथयन्तो मिथस्तत्र प्रशशंसुर्जनाधिपम्॥ अहो महात्मा राजायमिक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनः। ज्ञात्वा वृद्धं स्वमात्मानं रामं राज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यति ॥
en: Eagerly expecting the investiture of Rāma as the heir-apparent, all having thus ornamented the city and assembling them selves on terraces and in council-halls, talking with each other, extolled the lord of men, saying, “Ah high-souled is this king, the perpetuator of the Iksvāku race, for, knowing himself as old, he will install Rāma in the kingdom.

sa: ततस्तु राजा तं सूतं सन्नहर्षः सुतं प्रति॥ शोकरक्तेक्षणः श्रीमानुद्वीक्ष्योवाच धार्मिकः। वाक्यैस्तु खलु मर्माणि मम भूयो निकृन्तसि॥
en: Then the graceful and virtuous king, waxing disconsolate, on account of his son, and with his eyes reddened with the effect of grief, seeing the charioteer, said, “This eulogy of your pains me the more."

sa: प्रतिगृह्य तु तां पूजां जनकस्य महात्मनः॥ पप्रच्छ कुशलं राज्ञो यज्ञस्य च निरामयम्। स तांश्चाथ मुनीन् पृष्ट्वा सोपाध्यायपुरोधसः॥ यथार्हमृषिभिः सर्वैः समागच्छत् प्रहृष्टवत्।
en: Having accepted that homage of the highsouled Janaka, the ascetic enquired after the king's welfare, and the uninterrupted performance of his sacrifice. And the king together with his priests, having enquired of the ascetics as to their welfare, cheerfully embraced them all in a proper way.

sa: किंवीर्या राक्षसास्ते च कस्य पुत्राश्च के च ते॥ कथंप्रमाणाः के चैतान् रक्षन्ति मुनिपुङ्गव। कथं च प्रतिकर्तव्यं तेषां रामेण रक्षसाम्॥ मामकैर्वा बलैर्ब्रह्मन् मया वा कूटयोधिनाम्। सर्वं मे शंस भगवन् कथं तेषां मया रणे॥ स्थातव्यं दुष्टभावानां वीर्योत्सित्ता हि राक्षसाः।
en: What is the prowess of the Rākşasas? And whose sons are they? And who, pray are they? And what are the proportions of their bodies? And who protects them O foremost of ascetics? And by what means shall either Rāma, or my forces, or, O Brahman, I myself be able to slay in fight those deceitful warriors—the Rākṣasas? Do you tell me, O adorable ore, inflated as they are by virtue of their prowess, how can I stand them in fight?

sa: ततस्तेनैव शोकेन गृधं दग्ध्वा जटायुषम्॥ मार्गमाणो वने सीतां राक्षसं संददर्श ह। कबन्धं नाम रूपेण विकृतं घोरदर्शनम्॥ तं निहत्य महाबाहुर्ददाह स्वर्गतश्च सः।
en: Having with unassuaged sorrow burnt the vulture Jațāyu, as he was searching for Sità in that forest, he fell in with a Rākṣasa, Kabandha by name, of a dreadful and deformed shape. Having slain him, the mighty-armed one burnt his body,-and thereupon he went to heaven.

sa: अयमिक्ष्वाकुदायादस्त्रिशङ्कुरिति विश्रुतः। धर्मिष्ठश्च वदान्यश्च मां चैव शरणं गतः॥ स्वेनानेन शरीरेण देवलोकजिगीषया। यथायं स्वशरीरेण देवलोकं गमिष्यति॥ तथा प्रवर्त्यतां यज्ञो भवद्भिश्च मया सह।
en: This descendant of Ikşvāku, the famous Trišanku, is virtuous and munificent, and has taken refuge in me, with the view of attaining the celestial regions in his own person. Therefore do you engage with me in the sacrifice, so that he may bodily repair to heaven.

sa: स तु दूरमुपागम्य सर्वैस्तैः कपिसत्तमैः। ततो विचित्य विन्ध्यस्य गुहाश्च गहनानि च॥ पर्वताग्रनदीदुर्गान् सरांसि विपुलदुमान्। वृक्षखण्डाश्च विविधान् पर्वतान् वनपादपान्॥ अन्वेषमाणास्ते सर्वे वानराः सर्वतोदिशम्। न सीतां ददृशुर्वीरा मैथिली जनकात्मजाम्॥
en: And having proceeded far along with all those foremost of monkeys, he explored the caves and woods of Vindhya; spots inaccessible in consequence of streams intervening in front of mountains; and tanks; and tracts filled with trees; and various mountains rife with wild trees. And having searched in all directions, the monkeys could not find Maithilī, Janaka's daughter Sītā.

sa: गोदावरी प्रवक्ष्यामि हीना रामेण लक्ष्मण। आबन्धिष्येऽथवा त्यक्ष्ये विषमे देहमात्मनः॥ पिबामि वा विषं तीक्ष्णं प्रवेक्ष्यामि हुताशनम्। न त्वहं राघवादन्यं कदापि पुरुषं स्पृशे॥
en: Without Rama, O Laksmana, I shall drink virulent poison, enter fire or dive into the Godāverī. I shall destroy this body either by hanging or by falling down from the top of a high object. I shall never be able to touch another man but Rāma.

sa: तेनैव पूर्वमाक्रान्त आश्रमः श्रमनाशनः। मयापि भक्त्या तस्यैव वामनस्योपभुज्यते॥ एनमाश्रममायान्ति राक्षसा विघ्नकारिणः। अत्र ते पुरुषव्याघ्र हन्तव्या दुष्टचारिणः॥
en: Formerly he used to dwell in this asylum capable of removing fatigue. And hermitage is infested by Raksasas disturbing rites. And, O most puissant of men, here you should slay those ones of wicked ways.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच एवं भवतु कल्याणि यथा त्वमभिभाषसे। द्वितीयं ते वरं भद्रे ददानि वरयस्व ह। मनो हि मे वितरति नैकं त्वं वरमर्हसि॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O blessed girl, what you have said, let it be so. O excellent one, ask for a second boon. I shall grant it to you. My heart desires to give you a second boon. You do not deserve to get only one boon. me

sa: महद्ध्येतदचिन्त्यं च यदहं दृष्टवान् प्रभो। इत्युक्तः स मया श्रीमान् देवदेवो महाद्युतिः। सान्त्वयन् मामिदं वाक्यमुवाच वदतां वरः॥
en: lord, what I have seen is wonderful and inconceivable.” Having been thus addressed by me, that highly effulgent and blessed god of gods, that foremost of all speakers, duly consoling me, thus spoke to me.

sa: तत्र सौगन्धिकानां च पुष्पाणां पुण्यगन्धिनाम्। उद्वीज्यमानो मिश्रेण वायुना पुण्यगन्धिना॥ नन्दनं च वनं दिव्यमप्सरोगणसेवितम्। ददर्श दिव्यकुसुमैराह्वयद्भिरिव दुमैः॥
en: Here as if fanned by the fragrant breezes charged with the fragrance of sweet scented flowers and invited by the celestials flowers and trees he saw the celestials garden Nandana resorted to by the Apsaras.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच गच्छन् स तीर्थानि महानुभावः पुण्यानि रम्याणि ददर्श राजा। सर्वाणि विप्रैरुपशोभितानि क्वचित् क्वचिद् भारत सागरस्य॥
en: Vaishampayana said : That magnanimous king then went to many sacred places and to various spots on the seashore, all adorned with the presence of Brahmanas. (He went to many) charming Tirthas and saw them.

sa: न त गन्धर्वराजस्य सैनिका मन्दचेतसः॥ शक्यन्ते मृदुना श्रेयः प्रति श्रेयः प्रतिपादयितुं तदा। ततस्तान् युधि दुर्धर्षान् सव्यसाची परंतपः॥ सान्त्वपूर्वमिदं वाक्यमुवाच खचरान् रणे। विसर्जयत राजानं भ्रातरं मे सुयोधनम्॥
en: But the foolish minded soldiers of the Gandharva chief were seen by that chastiser of foes Savyasachi (Arjuna) that they could not be by means of a light skirmish made to understand what was good for them. He thus spoke to those rangers of the sky in these conciliatory words, “Let off my brother, the king Duryodhana.”

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच गावल्गणे संजय स्वागतं ते प्रीयामहे ते वयं दर्शनेन। अनामयं प्रतिजाने तवाहं सहानुजै:कुशली चास्मि विद्वन्॥
en: Yudhishthira said O son of Gavalgana, O Sanjaya, you are welcome. We are delighted at seeing you. In return to know about your health. I am well with my younger brothers. O you learned man.

sa: नाहं शप्तः प्रतिशपामि कंचिद् दमं द्वारं ह्यमृतस्येह वेद्मिा गुह्यं ब्रह्म तदिदं ब्रवीमि न मानुषाच्छ्रेष्ठतरं हिं किंचित्॥
en: If cursed I do not curse in return. I know that self-control is the door of immortality. I disclose to you a great mystery. There is no position that is superior to that of humanity.

sa: ययातिरुवाच यावत् पृथिव्यां विहितं गवावं सहारण्यैः पशुभिः पार्वतैश्च। तावल्लोका दिवि ते संस्थिता वै तथा विजानीहि नरेन्द्रसिंह॥
en: Yayati said : O best of kings, there are many regions for you to enjoy in heaven, as many as the kine and horses of earth, as the animals in the wilderness and the hills.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः स नृपशार्दूल पूरुं राज्येऽभिषिच्य च। ततः सुचरितं कृत्वा भृगुतुङ्गे महातपाः॥ कालेन महता पश्चात् कालधर्ममुपेयिवान्। कारयित्वा त्वनशनं सदारः स्वर्गमाप्तवान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : That best of kings, (Yayati), having installed Puru on the throne went to the mount Bhrigu to become a great ascetic. After many years he succumbed to the inevitable influence of Time. Observing the vow of fasting, he ascended heaven with his wives.

sa: एकोनषष्टिरध्यायाः पर्वण्यत्र प्रकीर्तिताः। संख्याता बहुवृत्तान्ताः श्लोकसंख्याऽत्र कथ्यते॥ त्रीणि श्लोकसहस्राणि द्वे शते विंशतिस्तथा। मुनिना संप्रणीतानि कौरवाणां यशोभृता॥
en: The number of chapters in this Parva is fifty-nine and the number of slokas composed by the great Vyasa, the spreader of the fame of the Kuru Dynasty, is three thousand two hundred and twenty.

sa: संक्रुद्धो राक्षसस्तस्या भगिन्याः कुरुसत्तम्। उत्फाल्य विपुले नेत्रे ततस्तामिदमब्रवीत्॥ को हि मे भोक्तुकामस्य विजं चरित दुर्मतिः। न विभेषि हिडिम्बे किं मत्कोपाद् विप्रमोहिता।१७।।
en: O best of the Kurus, becoming angry with his sister, the Rakshasas expanded his large eyes and thus spoke to her, "What foolish creature throws obstacle on my way when I am hungry; O Hidimba, have you become so senseless as not to fear my anger?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स पीडितो देवयान्या महर्षिः समाह्वयत् संरम्भाचैव काव्यः। असंशयं मामसुरा द्विषन्ति ये मे शिष्यानागतान् सूदयन्ति॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The great Rishi (Shukra), the son of Kavi, being much afflicted by Devayani's words, cried in anger, "The Asuras certainly want to injure me, for they killed my disciple living with ime.

sa: भरिष्यामि च ते भार्यां प्रतीच्छेमां द्विजोत्तम। रक्षणं च करिष्येऽस्याः सर्वशक्त्या तपोधन। त्वदर्थं रक्ष्यते चैषा मया मुनिवरोत्तम॥
en: I shall support her, O best of Brahmanas and therefore accept her. O Rishi, I shall protect her with all my abilities. O best of Rishis, she has been brought up by me for you.”

sa: कष्टं युद्धे दश शेषाः श्रुता मे त्रयोऽस्माकं पाण्डवानां च सप्त। ह्यूना विंशतिराहताऽक्षौहिणीनां तस्मिन् संग्रामे भैरवे क्षत्रियाणाम्॥
en: Alas! I have heard that only ten persons are alive in this war three on our side and seven the side of the Pandavas. Eighteen Akshauhinis of Kshatriyas have been slain in this fearful battle.

sa: यावच्च कुर्यादन्योऽस्य कुर्याद् बहुगुणं ततः। दृष्ट्वा भीमस्य विक्रान्तं तदा जदुगृहे महत्। हिडिम्बस्य वधाच्चैवं विश्वासो मे वृकोदरे॥
en: It is (always) proper that the requital should be greater than the service received. Seeing the great prowess of Bhima in the house of lac. And in killing Hidimba, my confidence on Vrikodara is great.

sa: कामोपभोगेन रहस्तस्यां तुष्टिमगादृषिः। तया सहोषितो राजन् महर्षिः संशितव्रतः॥ उत्तिष्ठन्नववीदेनामभुजिष्या भविष्यसि। अयं च ते शुभे गर्भः श्रेयानुदरमागतः। धर्मात्मा भविता लोके सर्वबुद्धिमतां वरः॥
en: O king, the Rishi of rigid vows was greatly pleased with her. When he rose (to go away) he said, “O amiable girl, you shall no longer remain a maid-servant. Your son will be greatly fortunate, virtuous and the foremost of all intelligent men on earth.”

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच प्रार्थितो राजसूयो मे न चासौ केवलेप्सया। प्राप्यते येन तत् ते हि विदितं कृष्ण सर्वशः॥
en: Yudhishthira said. O Krishna, I have desired to perform the Rajasuya sacrifice, but it cannot be performed as by my simply wishing to perform it. You know every thing by which it may be accomplished.

sa: भगवन् द्रष्टुमिच्छामि पितामहसभां शुभाम्। येन वा तपसा शक्या कर्मणा वापि गोपते॥ औषधैर्वा तथा युक्तैरुत्तमा पापनाशिनी। तन्ममाचक्ष्व भगवन् पश्येयं तां सभा यथा॥
en: "O illustrious one, I desire to see the sacred Sabha of the Grandsire. O exalted one, O lord of light, tell me by what ascetic penances, by what acts, by what charms, and by what rites, I may be able to see that sincleansing excellent Sabha."

sa: तमर्थं चिन्तयानोऽहं मुहूर्तं तत्र राघव॥ विष्ठितोऽस्मि सरस्तीरे किन्विदं स्यादिति प्रभो। अथापश्यं सुमूर्तात्तु दिव्यमद्भुतदर्शनम्॥ विमानं परमोदारं हंसयुक्तं मनोजवम्। अत्यर्थं स्वर्गिणं त विमाने रघुनन्दन॥ उपास्तेऽप्सरसां वीर सहस्रं दिव्यभूषणम्।
en: Beholding it and standing on the banks I began to mediate upon it. And thought I What is this?' In a moment I espied a beautiful car, swiftcoursing like the mind and drawn by ganders. And I saw in that chariot a celestial person. He was being attended by Apsarās adorned with celestial ornaments and having lotus-eyes.

sa: विष्णुरेवादिसर्गेषु स्वयम्भूर्भवति प्रभुः॥ एवं हि यो वेद गुहाशय प्रभु परं पुराणं पुरुष विश्वरूपम्। हिरण्मयं बुद्धिमतां परां गतिं स बुद्धिमान् बुद्धिमतीत्य तिष्ठति॥
en: The self-create Vishnu becomes the Lord in the primary creations. He who thus knows the Lord lying in the cave, the Supreme, Ancient Being, of universal form, the golded one, the highest goal of all persons gifted with understanding, that intelligent man lives, transcending the understanding.

sa: अहो धिङ् नार्हसे देवि वक्तुं मामीदृशं वचः। अहं हि वचनाद् राज्ञः पतेयमपि पावके॥ भक्षयेयं विषं तीक्ष्णं पतेयमपि चार्णवे। नियुक्तो गुरुणा पित्रा नृपेण च हितेन च॥ तद् ब्रूहि वचनं देवि राज्ञो यदभिकाशितम्। करिष्ये प्रतिजाने च रामो द्विर्नाभिभाषते ॥
en: Oh! shame to me. May it not please you, Oh worshipful lady, to speak such words to me. I can at the king's words jump into the fire. Being ordered by him, who is my father and who is my king especially, I can drink virulent poison and drown into the ocean. Speak you, Oh worshipful lady, what is the desire of the king, and know that I shall carry it out, Rāma does not contradict what he has once spoken.

sa: वदस्व तत्त्वेन कच्चित् सवर्णप्रवरो मनुष्य उद्रिक्तवर्णोऽप्युत एव कच्चित्। कच्चिन्न वामो मम मूर्ध्नि पादः कृष्णाभिमर्शेन कृतोऽद्य पुत्र॥
en: O son, has any Kshatriya of high birth, or any one of the superior order (Brahmana) obtained my daughter? Has a man of low birth placed his left foot on my head by winning Krishna?

sa: गदामुसलरुग्णानां भिन्नानां च वरासिभिः। दन्तिदन्तावभिन्नानां मृदितानां च दन्तिभिः॥ तत्र तत्र नरौघाणां क्रोशतामितरेतरम्। शुश्रुवुर्दारुणा वाचः प्रेतानामिव भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, crushed with maces and clubs, cut off with tempered swords pierced and grinned by the tusks of elephants, the combatants sent forth heart-rending wails as those of men doomed to hell.

sa: धन्विनः पुरुषाः केचित् परिवार्य महारथान्। एकं बहव आसाद्य प्रययुर्यमसादनम्॥ नागान् रथवरांश्चान्ये परिवार्य महारथाः। सान्तरायोधिनं जघ्नुर्द्रवमाणं महारथम्॥
en: Some bowmen, surrounding great carwarriors, killed them. Encompassing elephant and great warriors of their own class, other great car-warriors killed some mighty one amongst them that fought in the field moving about on all sides.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रुद्धो दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान्। निरीक्ष्य तु बलं सर्वं दैवतैर्विनिपातितम्॥ स तं प्रतिविगाह्याशु प्रवृद्धं सैन्यसागरम्। त्रिदशान्समरे निघ्नशक्रमेवाभ्यवर्तत॥
en: Having beheld his own army slain by the deities the highly powerful Daśänana, enraged beholding the army slain by gods, entered the ocean of celestial army and slaying the deities in the conflict confronted Sakra.

sa: गच्छन्तं तु नरव्याघ्र सर्षिसङ्घ सराघवम्॥ घोरास्तु पक्षिणो वाचो व्याहरन्ति समन्ततः। भौमाश्चैव मृगाः सर्वे गच्छन्ति स्म प्रदक्षिणम्॥
en: As that tiger-like one was on his way, in company with Rāghava and the saints, the fowls began to utter frightful cries all around, and the beasts on earth to stream in a Southern direction.

sa: ततस्तं रथमास्थाय रावणार्पितशासनः॥ लङ्काया निर्ययौ तूर्णं बलेन महता वृतः। ततो दुन्दुभिनिर्घोषः पर्जन्यनिनदोपमः।। वादित्राणां न निनदः पूरयन्निव मेदिनीम्॥ शुश्रुवे शङ्खशब्दश्च प्रयाते वाहिनीपतौ।
en: Then ascending this car, Prahasta, whom Rāvana had entrusted with authority, surrounded by a vast host, swiftly went out of Larkā. And then there were heard the sounds of kettledrums, resembling the roars of Parjanya, and the sounds of musical instruments, as if filling the Earth.

sa: प्रसादं कुरु सुश्रोणि न कालं क्षेप्तुमर्हसि। त्वत्कृते हि मम प्राणा विदीर्यन्ते वरानने॥ त्वां प्राप्य तु वधो वापि पापं वापि सुदारुणम्। भक्तं भजस्व मां भीरु भजमानं सुविह्वलम्॥
en: Be you propitiated with me, O you having a graceful person; do not tarry even for a moment. My heart bursts out for you, O you having a moon-like countenance. For acquiring you I can even take upon myself my own destruction or dreadful iniquity. Do you seek me, O fair ladyI am beside myself for you.

sa: प्रसादं कुरु सुश्रोणि न कालं क्षेप्तुमर्हसि। त्वत्कृते हि मम प्राणा विदीर्यन्ते वरानने॥ त्वां प्राप्य तु वधो वापि पापं वापि सुदारुणम्। भक्तं भजस्व मां भीरु भजमानं सुविह्वलम्॥
en: Be you propitiated with me, O you having a graceful person; do not tarry even for a moment. My heart bursts out for you, O you having a moon-like countenance. For acquiring you I can even take upon myself my own destruction or dreadful iniquity. Do you seek me, O fair ladyI am beside myself for you.

sa: चिक्रीडुश्च तथैवान्ये जहसुश्च तवाहिताः। अब्रुवंश्चासकृद् वीरा भीमसेनमिदं वचः॥ दुष्करं भवता कर्म रणेऽद्य सुमहत् कृतम्। कौरवेन्द्रं रणे हत्वा गदयाऽतिकृतश्रमम्॥ इन्द्रेणेव हि वृत्रस्य वधं परमसंयुगे। त्वया कृतममन्यन्त शत्रोर्वधमिमं जनाः॥
en: Some sported and juinped about others laughed aloud. Many heroes repeatedly said these words to Bhimasena— 'Highly difficult and great has been the feat that you have performed to-day in batile, by having struck down thc Kuru king, himself a great warrior, with your macc! This slaughter of your enemy is considered like that of Vritra by Indra himself!

sa: वासुदेव उवाच तमो रजश्च सत्वं च विद्धि भावान् मदाश्रयान्। तथा रुदान् वसून् वापि विद्धि मत्प्रभवान् द्विज॥
en: Vasudeva said Know that the three qualities of Ignorance, Darkness and Goodness exist, depending on me as their refuge. So also, O twice-born one, know that the Rudras and the Vasus have originated from me.

sa: समानयत मे शीघ्रं राक्षसानां महाबलम्। मद्बाणानां तु वेगेन हतानां तु रणाजिरे॥ अद्य तृप्यन्तु मांसादाः पक्षिणः काननौकसः।
en: At once bring up the mighty host of Raksasas Today in the field of fight will I entertain the flesh-feeding fowls of the forest with the bodies of the foes slain with my resistless shafts.

sa: भीमसेन उवाच त्वां राजन् राजपुत्रीं च यमौ च पुरुषर्षभ। स्वयं नेष्यामि राजेन्द्र मा विषादे मनः कृथाः॥
en: Bhima said: O king, I myself will carry the princess and also these two foremost of men, the twins and yourself; therefore O king of kings, do not allow anxiety to come to your mind.

sa: ब्राह्मणः उवाच विवस्वतो गच्छति पर्ययेण वोढुं भवांस्तं रथमेकचक्रम्। आश्चर्यभूतं यदि तत्र किंचिद् दृष्टं त्वया शंसितुमर्हसि त्वम्॥
en: The Brahmana said You go for dragging the one-wheeled car of Vivasvat according to your turn. You should describe to me anything wonderful that you may have seen in those regions through which you pass.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि शृणु राजन् युधिष्ठिर। धर्मिष्ठमिदमाख्यानं धुन्धुमारस्य तच्छृणु॥
en: Markandeya said : O king Yudhishthira, I shall tell you all. Listen to me. The story of Dhundhumara is a moral story, hear it.

sa: शौनक उवाच सूतपुत्र यथा तस्य भार्गवस्य महात्मनः। च्यवनत्वं परिख्यातं तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः॥
en: Shaunaka said : O Son of Suta, why was the illustrious son of Bhrigu named Chyavana? I ask you, tell me all about it.

sa: हतांश्चाधर्मतः श्रुत्वा शोकार्ताः शुशुचुर्हि ते। भीष्मं द्रोणं तथा कर्णं भूरिश्रवसमेव च॥
en: Hearing the invisible voice the Bhishma and Drona and Karna and Bhurishravas were killed unfairly, they were afflicted with remorse and wept in grief.

sa: स एवमुक्तस्तमुपाध्यायं प्रत्युवाच-'भो एतासां गवां पयसा वृत्ति कल्पयामि' इति। तमुवाचोपाध्यायः 'नैतन्याय्यं पय उपयोक्तुम्। भवतो मया नाभ्यनुज्ञात' इति॥
en: Upamanyu, thus questioned, replied, “Sir, I now support myself with the milk of these cows.” Hearing which the preceptor said, “It is not proper for you to drink the milk, since you were not addressed by me."

sa: रामो नाम महातेजाः श्रेष्ठः सर्वधनुष्मताम्। दिव्यास्त्रगुणसम्पन्नः परं धर्मं गतो युधि ॥
en: (He) is named Rama, and is exceedingly energetic; the foremost of al bowmenfurnished with celestial panoply; and is possessed of pre-eminent prowess in warfare.

sa: ऊर्ध्वबाहुर्विरोम्येष न च कश्चिच्छणोति मे। धर्मादर्थश्च कामश्च स किमर्थं न सेव्यते॥
en: With uplifted arms I am crying aloud but nobody hears me. From Virtue originate Profit and Pleasure. Why should not Virtue, therefore, be sought?

sa: पितॄन् संतर्पयित्वा तु बलिं कुर्याद् विधानतः। वैश्वदेवं ततः कुर्यात् पश्चाद् ब्राह्मणवाचनम्॥
en: He should then make offerings to the Vishwedevas. He should next invite Brahmanas, and then properly entertain guests arrived at his house, with food.

sa: न मे प्रियं महाबाहो यद् गताः पाण्डवा वनम्। निकृत्या निकृताश्चैव दुर्योधनपुरोगमैः॥
en: O mighty-armed hero, it has not pleased me that the Pandavas have gone to the forest, having been dishonestly defeated by Duryodhana and others.

sa: यथा देवासुरे युद्धे त्रिदशा वज्रधारिणम्। सर्वे ते स्म व्यतिष्ठन्ति रक्षन्तस्तं महारथम्॥
en: Protecting that mighty car-warrior Bhishma, they stood like the celestial protecting the wielder of the thunder-bolt in the battle between themselves and the Asuras.

sa: रोचते यदि मे सख्यं बाहुरेष प्रसारितः। गृह्यतां पाणिना पाणिर्मर्यादा बध्यतां ध्रुवा॥
en: If you relish friendship with me, do you take this stretched arm and my hand with yours, and bind yourself fast with a vow.

sa: अष्टादशपुराणानां श्रवणाद् यत् फलं भवेत्। तत् फलं समवाप्नोति वैष्णवो नात्र संशयः॥
en: One devoted to Vishnu acquires (through this) that merit which is acquired by listening to the eighteen Puranas. There is no doubt in this.

sa: मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया दुष्टुमिति प्रभो। योगेश्वर ततो मे त्वं दर्शयात्मानमव्ययम्॥
en: If, O Lord, you think that I am competent to see that form, then, O Lord of mystic powers, show me your inexhaustible form.

sa: शुक्लपक्षे दशम्यां च पुण्डीरकं समाविशेत्। तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् पुण्डरीकफलं लभेत्॥
en: O king, one should go on the tenth of the white fortnight to Pundarika. Bathing there, a man obtains the fruits of Pundarika sacrifice.

sa: मया प्रमाणं हि कृतं लोकः समनुवर्तते॥ प्रमाणानि हि पूज्यानि ततस्तं पूजयाम्यहम्।
en: The ordinances I set are followed by all the worlds. Those ordinances should always be worshipped, and it is, therefore, that I worship them.

sa: दुराचारो हि पुरुषो नेहायुर्विन्दते महत्। त्रसन्ति यस्माद् भूतानि तथा परिभवन्ति च॥
en: The man whose conduct is improper or wicked never acquires a long life. All creatures fear such a man and are oppressed by him.

sa: ततस्तां क्षत्रियामपश्यत् सा च दृष्ट्वैवोत्तत प्रत्युत्थायाभिवाद्योवाच स्वागतं ते भगवन्नाज्ञापय किं करवाणीति॥
en: He saw the queen this time. Seeing him, she saluted him reverentially and said, “Welcome, Sir; command me what I shall do for you.

sa: रामेण यदि ते पापे किंचित्कृतमशोभनम्। अपकारः क इह ते वैदेह्या दर्शितोऽधमे॥
en: If, O wicked woman, Rāma has happened to do you something unbeautiful, what wrong, O base wretch, has Vaidehi done you in the world?

sa: तत्र दत्त्वा हलधरो विप्रेभ्यो विविधं वसु॥ अजाविकं गोखरोष्ट्रं सुवर्णं रजतं तथा।
en: Giving away various kinds of riches to the Brahmanas, as also goat and sheep and kine and mules and camels and gold and silver.

sa: स्वयमेव हि विश्रम्य ज्ञात्वा कालमुपागतम्। उपकारं च सुग्रीवो वेत्स्यते नात्र संशयः॥
en: Forsooth, shall Sugrīva think of the benefits (he has received from me) after enjoying rest for sometime, when the time for action shall arrive.

sa: लुब्धक उवाच युवामुभौ कालवशौ यदि मे मृत्युपन्नगौ। हर्षक्रोधौ यथा स्यातामेतदिच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
en: The fowler said If you both, O serpent and Mrityu, depend on Kala. I am curious to know how pleasure and anger are caused.

sa: स तेभ्यस्तु नमस्कृत्वा सुग्रीवाय च मारुतिः। दिशः सर्वाः समालोक्य सोऽशोकवनिका प्रति॥
en: Having bowed to them all, as also to Sugrīva, the offspring of the Wind-god, surveying all he cardinal points, mentally entered the Asoka wood.

sa: युष्मान्संबोधयाम्येष यया न स हरेबलात्। अतुलं हि बलं तस्य बृहस्पतिरुवाच ह॥
en: I warn you beforehand, so that he may not succeed in taking it by force. Brihaspati has told me that his strength is matchless."

sa: वैकृतं तन्महद् दृष्ट्वा भुजवीर्यं तथा युधि। दिव्यानां च महास्त्राणां विनाशाद् व्रीडितोऽभवत्॥५६
en: Seeing that furious battle, the loss of the might of his arm, and the non appearance of his celestial weapons, Arjuna became greatly ashamed.

sa: वक्त्राणि ते त्वरमाणा विशन्ति दंष्ट्राकरालानि भयानकानि। केचिद् विलग्ना दशनान्तरेषु संदृश्यन्ते चूर्णितैरुत्तमाङ्गैः॥
en: Are quickly entering your terrible mouths, rendered more terrible by they tusks. Some, with their heads crushed, stick at the interstices of your teeth

sa: तिस्रो देवीर्यदा चैव भजते भुवनेश्वरः। द्यामपः पृथिवीं चैव त्र्यम्बकश्च ततः स्मृतः॥
en: As three goddesses viz., the sky, the firmament and the water, ever worship that lord of the worlds, therefore he is truly calied Tryambaka.

sa: प्राङ्नाम तस्य कथितं वसुषेण इति क्षितौ। को वैकर्तनश्चैव कर्मणा तेन सोऽभवत्॥
en: The son of Surya was known by the name of Vasushena, but after his cutting off his natural armour, he was called Karna (cutter).

sa: वयं हि धार्तराष्ट्राश्च कालमन्युवंशगताः। कृत्वेदं निन्दितं कर्म प्राप्स्यामः कां गतिं नृप।॥
en: Tell us, O prince, what will befall us and the sons of Dhritarashtra, who, impelled by fate and anger, have done this hateful act.

sa: पतङ्गा वृश्चिकाः कीटा दंशाश्च मशकैः सह। बाधन्ते नित्यमबले सर्वं दुःखमतो वनम्॥
en: Birds, scorpions, insects mosquito's and wild gnats, always disturb the dwellers, O fair one' of the weaker sex; so the wood is full misery.

sa: ततः पञ्चवटीं गत्वा ब्रह्मचारी जितेन्द्रियः। पुण्येन महता युक्तः सतां लोके महीयते॥
en: Then going to Panchavati with passions controlled and with Brahmacharya life, one becomes greatly virtuous and is adored in the region of the virtuous.

sa: भक्त्या त्वनन्यया शक्य अहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन। ज्ञातुं द्रष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परंतप॥
en: But by exclusive devotion to me, O Arjuna, O chastiser of foes, I can, in this form, be known, truly seen and attained to.

sa: दृष्ट एव हि नः शोकमपनेष्यति राघवः। तमः सर्वस्य लोकस्य समुद्यन्निव भास्करः॥
en: As soon as we shall see him, Rāghava will remove our sorrow; even as the Sun arising dispels the darkness of the entire world.

sa: ता बाष्पेण च संवीताः शोकेन विपुलेन च। व्यचेष्टन्त निरानन्दा राघवस्य वरस्त्रियः॥
en: Thus with tears in their eyes, the wives of that descendant of Raghu, joyless and convulsed with a huge passion, displayed signs of sorrow.

sa: आख्यातव्यं त्वेव सर्वं मुमूर्षोर्मया तुभ्यं पृष्टया धर्म एषः। न मे व्यथा विद्यते त्वद्भयं वा सम्पश्यन्त्याः सानुजं धर्मराजम्॥
en: Still, as you, being on the point of death, have asked me, I shall relate it for such is the duty; seeing Dharmaraja with his younger brothers I have not the slightest anxiety or fear from you.

sa: कतमो राजवंशोऽयं विशालायां महामुने। श्रोतुमिच्छामि भद्रं ते परं कौतूहलं हि मे॥
en: O mighty ascetic, what royal line reside in yonder large city? I desire to hear this, good betide you; and great is my curiosity.

sa: सरस्वती ततः सोमः स जगामर्षिशासनात्। प्रभासं प्रथमं तीर्थं सरस्वत्या जगाम ह॥
en: Thus commanded by the Rishi Daksha, Soma then proceeded to the Sarasvati. He reached the greatest of tirthas called Prabhasa belonging to the Sarasvati.

sa: संजय उवाच ततो व्यूढेष्वनीकेषु समुत्कृष्टेषु मारिष। ताड्यमानासु भेरीषु मृदङ्गेषु नदत्सु च॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus when the troops had been excellently disposed of in that array, Osire and when Bheris were sounded and Mridangas struck up.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच एवमेतन्महाबाहो यथा वदसि भारत। इदमन्यत् समादत्स्व वाच्यं मे वाक्यकोविद॥
en: Yudhishthira said: O descendant of Bharata, O mighty-armed hero, what you say is true. O best of speakers, listen (also) to what I say.

sa: अद्य मे पौरुषं दृष्टमद्य मे सफलः श्रमः। अद्य तीर्णप्रतिज्ञोऽहं प्रभवाम्यद्य चात्मनः॥
en: My manliness has been displayed today, my laboúr has been crowned with success and today I have fulfilled my promise by my own prowess.

sa: अयं गच्छामि कौरव्य कुरुक्षेत्रं त्वया सह। भाषितं ते करिष्यामि तत्रागच्छ परंतप॥
en: I shall now go, O son of Kuru, to Kurukshetra with you. I shall do what you say. Go there, O chastiser of foes.

sa: मान्धातोवाच एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं भगवंस्तद् ब्रवीहि मे। त्वं बन्धुभूतो ह्यस्माकं क्षत्रियाणां सुरेश्वर॥
en: I wish to hear all this, O illustrious god, instruct me. O chief of all the gods, you are the friend of us Kshatriyas.

sa: दृष्ट्वा फलं वा पुष्पं वा यच्चान्यत् स्त्रीमनोहरम्। बहुशो हा प्रियेत्येवं श्वसंस्त्वामभिभाषते॥
en: He always welcomes you sighing and saying “O my dear love!", whenever he beholds any fruit, flower or any object liked by the ladies.

sa: ब्रह्म क्षत्रेण संसृष्टं क्षत्रं च ब्रह्मणा सह। उदीर्णे दहतः शत्रून् वनानीवाग्निमारुतौ॥
en: Brahima-energy combined with Kshatriyaenergy, Brahma-prowess united with Kshatriya-prowess, when rendered strong, might consume the enemies as fire united with the wind consumes the forest.

sa: पश्य लक्ष्मण यक्षिण्या भैरवं दारुणं वपुः। भिद्येरन् दर्शनादस्या भीरूणां हृदयानि च॥
en: Behold, O Laksmana, the terrible and hideous body of yonder Yakṣiṇī! The sight of her strike terror into the hearts of even the brave.

sa: तत्र दत्त्वा च दानानि विशिष्टानि हलायुधः। उषित्वा रजनीमेकां स्नात्वा च विधिवत्तदा॥
en: Distributing many precious presents at that place, the hero, having the plough for his weapon, passed one night there and performed his absolutions duly.

sa: क्लिन्नवस्त्रस्य तु जले किंकरा राजनोदिताः। ददुर्वासांसि मेऽन्यानि तच्च दुःखं परं मम॥
en: My robes having been wet, the servants gave me other clothes at the command of the king (Yudhishthira). That also is my great sorrow.

sa: अपूजयन् मारुतिं च संहृष्टास्ते महाबलम्। प्रह्रादं समरे जित्वा यथा शक्रं मरुद्गणाः॥
en: Then filled with delight, they applauded the mighty son of Maruta the Marutas themselves applauded Shakra after he had vanquished Pralhada in battle. as

sa: यस्य ते वज्रनिष्पेषो न कुर्याद्व्यसनं सदा। स कथं रामबाणातः प्रसुप्तोऽसि महीतले॥
en: He who could not be harmed by the concussion of the thunder-bolt itself-how can he, smitten with Rāma's arrows, sleep soundly on the earth?

sa: भीमस्तु सारथिं हत्वा भीष्मस्य रथिनां वरः। प्रद्रुताश्वे रथे तस्मिन् द्रवमाणे समन्ततः॥
en: Then that foremost of car-warriors Bhima, slew the charioteer of Bhishma; thereupon the steeds having none to check them ran away dragging the chariot.

sa: श्रोत्रं त्व त्वक् चैव ऊर्ध्वं स्रोतस्तथा तिर्यगुत्पद्यति नराधिप। अष्टमं सर्गमित्याहुरेतदार्जवकं स्मृतम्॥
en: Then, O king, come the vital air that rises upwards and those that go downwards. This is the eighth creation and called Arjjva (straight).

sa: पुरा हि सोमो राजेन्द्र रोहिण्यामवसत् परम्। ततस्ताः कुपिताः सर्वा नक्षत्राख्या महात्मनः॥
en: Formerly, O king, Soma lived long with Rohini exclusively. For this, those other wives of his, the constellations, became displeased with that high-souled one.

sa: ता गत्वा पितरं प्राहुः प्रजापतिमतन्द्रिताः। सोमो वसति नास्मासु रोहिणी भजते सदा॥
en: Going to their father Daksha, that Lord of creation, they said to him-"Soma does not live with us. He always lives with Rohini only.

sa: कुशिक उवाच एष एव वरो मेऽद्य यस्त्वं प्रीतो महामुने। भवत्वेतद् यथाऽऽत्य त्वं भवेत् पौत्रो ममानघ॥ वरं गृहाण
en: Kushika said This, O great ascetic, is a high boon in my case, for you have been pleased with me! Let that take place which you have said! Let my grandson become a Brahmana, O sinless one.

sa: उक्तवानस्मि दुर्बुद्धिं मन्दं दुर्योधनं तदा॥ यतः कृष्णस्ततो धर्मो यतो धर्मस्ततो जयः।
en: Formerly, I spoke the foolish Duryodhana of wicked understanding that there is Virtue where Krishna is, and that there is victory where Virtue is.

sa: चक्षुषा यं प्रपश्यामि प्राणिनं पृथिवीपते। तस्य तेजो हराम्याशु तद्धि दृष्टेर्बलं मम॥
en: Such, O king, was the mysmeric power of my eyes, that all whatever creature I cast my looks, I instantly withdrew all his energy.

sa: त्वया च विपुलं राज्यं बलं धर्मे श्रुतं तथा। दत्तात्रेयप्रसादेन प्राप्तं परमदुर्लभम्॥
en: You, too, have acquired a large kingdom, great might, religious merit, and learning, which are all difficult of acquirement, through the grace of Dattatreya.

sa: नूनं तत्रागतो देवो यथा तैर्वागुदीरिता॥ वयं त्वेनं न पश्यामो मोहितास्तस्य मायया।
en: Forsooth, Hari appeared in that place whence the sound we heard originated. As regards ourselves, stupefied by His illusion, we could not behold Him.

sa: ततः स्थाणुवटं गच्छेत् त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्॥ तत्रा स्नात्वा स्थितो रात्रि रुद्रलोकमवाप्नुयात्।
en: One should then go to the Tirtha called Sthanuvata, celebrated all over the three worlds. Bathing there a man goes to the celestials region.

sa: तस्मादन्नमिदं सीते हविष्यान्नहं स्वयम्। स त्वां संगृह्य वैदेहि आगतः सह निद्रया।१४।।
en: And, O Sita, for this reason, I along with sleep, taking these rice, rice boiled in clarified butter, have, O Vaidehi, corne to you.

sa: अनादृत्य तु तद् वाक्यं दक्षस्य भगवाशशी। रोहिण्या सार्धमवसत् ततस्ताः कुपिताः पुनः॥
en: Disregarding, however, the behest of Daksha, the worshipful Soma continued to live with Rohini alone. At this, his other wives became once more angry.

sa: स मन्येऽहं तव प्रज्ञां यन्मोक्षात् प्रत्यनन्तरम्॥ भक्ष्यं मृगयसे नूनं सुखोपायेन कर्मणा।
en: I understand your wisdom. Having been released from the net, you speak highly of me so that you may easily make food to me.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच क्षत्रधर्माद्धि पापीयान्न धर्मोऽस्ति नराधिप। अपयानेन युद्धेन राजा हन्ति महाजनम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said No action O king, is more sinful than that of the Kshatriyas! While marching or in battle, the king destroys the Vaishyas.

sa: उच्चैर्वृत्तेः श्रियो हानिर्यथैव मरणं तथा। तस्मात् कोशं बलं मित्रमथ राजा विवर्धयेत्॥
en: Adversity is like death to a person of high rank. Therefore, the king should always multiply his treasury, and army, and allies and friends.

sa: ब्रह्मस्वे रक्ष्यमाणे तु सर्वं भवति रक्षितम्। तस्मात् तेषां प्रसादेन कृतकृत्यो भवेन्नृपः॥
en: Everything is protected by protecting Brahmana's wealth. Through the favour of the Brahmanas, which may thus be secured, the king becomes crowned with success.

sa: ते गत्वा दूरमध्वानं न्यग्रोधं प्रेक्ष्य मारिष। न्यविशन्त भृशं श्रान्ताश्चिन्तयन्तो नृपं प्रति॥
en: Having proceeded far, they beheld a banian tree under whose shade they stopped, greatly exhausted and exceedingly anxious about the king and thinking thus.

sa: रजसा तेन सम्पृक्तो भास्करो निष्प्रभः कृतः। संछादिताऽभवद् भूमिस्ते च शूरा महारथाः॥
en: On that dust being raised and the sun himself hidden therewith, the Earth became shrouded and the heroic and great car-warriors were not visible.

sa: कथं त्वं पृथिवीपालांस्त्यक्त्वा तात समागतान्। शेषे विनिहतो भूमौ प्राकृतः कुनृपो यथा।॥
en: Why, O sire, leaving all the assembled kings do you lie on the nacked ground, deprived of life, like an ordinary and wretched king?

sa: अमर्षणं युधां श्रेष्ठं कृतास्त्रं युद्धदुर्मदम्। शयानं वीरशयने पश्य माधव मे सुतम्॥
en: Look, O Madhava, at my son, that best of warriors, wrathful, expert in weapons, and irresistible in battle, sleeping on the bed of heroes.

sa: स एष निहतः शेते ब्रह्मदण्डेन राक्षसः। चार्वाको नृपतिश्रेष्ठ मा शुचो भरतर्षभ॥
en: That Rakshasa Charvaka, foremost of kings, killed by the curse of the Brahmanas, lies there, dead. Do not, O foremost of Bharata's race, grieve.

sa: सौहृदेनाभिभाषे त्वां कच्चिन्मार्जार जीवसि। जीवितं हि तवेच्छामि श्रेयः साधारणं हि नौ॥
en: I speak to you as a friend. O cat! Are you alive? I wish you to live! I seek the good of us both.

sa: न हि ते विक्रमे तुल्यः पुमानस्तीह कश्चन॥ श्रुतं तत् सर्वलोकेषु परमव्यसने यथा। द्वीपोऽभूस्त्वं हि पार्थानां नगरे वारणावते॥ हिडिम्बदर्शने चैव तथा त्वमभवो गतिः।
en: There is no one in this world equal to you in prowess. It is known throughout the world how during a great calamity you became at the town of Varanavata the refuge of all the Parthas. When again we seen by Hidimva, it was you who rescued us.

sa: अधर्मेण जितः पूर्वं तेन चापि युधिष्ठिरः। निकृताश्च सदैव स्म ततो विषममाचरम्॥
en: Duryodhana himself had formerly defeated Yudhishthira unfairly. He always acted treacherously towards us. It was therefore that I had recourse to an unfair act.

sa: केषु विश्वसितव्यं स्याद् राज्ञा कस्याञ्चिदापदि। कुतो वाऽऽत्मा दृढं रक्ष्यस्तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Whom should the king trust in what sorts of distress and danger? What evils should the king avoid? Tell me all this, O grandfather.

sa: विस्त्रंसयन्ति मन्त्रं च विवृण्वन्ति च दुष्कृतम्। लीलया चैव कुर्वन्ति सावज्ञास्तस्य शासनम्॥
en: They give out the secret counsels of their master and speak of his evil deeds. Without the least anxiety they disregard the king's commands.

sa: ते वयं सहितास्तात सर्वाशत्रून् समागतान्। प्रसह्य समरे हत्वा प्रीतिं प्राप्स्याम पुष्कलाम्॥ विश्रमस्व त्वमव्यग्रः स्वप चेमां निशां सुखम्।
en: All of us, in a body, O son, shall succeed in killing our assembled foes in battle by displaying our powers. Great shall be our happiness then. Removing your anxiety, rest for this night and sleep happily.

sa: यस्तु तां स्पर्धया क्षुद्रः पाञ्चालीमानयत् सभाम्। स हतो भीमसेनेन वैरं प्रतिजिहीर्षता॥
en: That mean wretch who had, from haughtiness caused the princess of Panchala to be brought into the court, has been justly killed by Bhimasena.

sa: तव पुत्रा हताः सर्वे द्रौपदेयाश्च भारत। कर्णपुत्रो हतः शूरो वृषसेनः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Your sons as also the five sons of Draupadi have been killed. The valiant and powerful son of Karna, Vrishasena, has also been killed.

sa: स ते वक्ष्यति धर्मज्ञः सूक्ष्मधर्मार्थतत्त्ववित्। तमभ्येहि पुरा प्राणान् स विमुञ्चति धर्मवित्॥
en: Conversant with all duties and the subtile truths of morality, he wili describe to you the duty and morality. See him before he dies.

sa: तेन धर्मेण महता सुखं लब्धेन भावितः। पाह्यस्मान् सर्वतो राजन् देवानिव शतक्रतुः॥
en: Strengthened by that merit so easily acquired by you do you protect us, o king, like Indra of a hundred sacrifices protecting the gods.

sa: इदं धनुरियं शक्तिरिदं चक्रमियं गदा। यद्यदिच्छसि चेदस्त्रं मत्तस्तत् तद् ददामि ते॥
en: I have this bow, this arrow, this discus, and the mace! I will give you whichever amongst them you wish to have from me.

sa: जनयामास यं देवी दिव्या त्रिपथगा नदी। साक्षाद् ददर्श यो देवान् सर्वानिन्द्रपुरोगमान्॥
en: That goddess the celestial river of three courses, gave birth to him. He saw with his physical eyes all the celestials headed by Indra.

sa: ततः कृष्णस्य वचनात् सात्यकिस्त्वरितो ययौ। उपगम्य च राजानं युधिष्ठिरमभाषत॥ युक्तो रथवरो राजन् वासुदेवस्य धीमतः। समीपमापगेयस्य प्रयास्यति जनार्दनः॥
en: Thus commanded by Krishna, Satyaki, proceeding quickly to the royal son of Pandu, said to him-'The foremost of cars, belonging to the highly intelligent Vasudeva, is ready, O king, for Janardana will go to see Ganga's son.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एवमेतन्महाप्राज्ञ यथा वदसि बुद्धिमन्। दुर्लभः पुरुषः कश्चिदेभिर्युक्तो गुणैः शुभैः॥
en: You are highly intelligent, O Yudhishthira! It is what you say. The person is very rare who is endued with all those good qualities.

sa: यो न कामान्न संरम्भान्न भयानार्थकारणात्। कुर्यादधर्मं धर्मात्मा स मां पृच्छतु पाण्डवः॥
en: Let the pious son of Pandu, who would never commit a sin actuated by desire of pleasure of profit or from fear, question me.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय सात्यकिः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः। द्वाभ्यां मद्रेश्वरं विद्ध्वा सारथिं च त्रिभिः शरैः॥
en: Beside himself with age Satyaki took up another bow and cut the king of the Madras with two arrows and his driver with three.

sa: ते वार्यमाणाः समरे मद्रराज्ञा महारथाः। न शेकुः सम्मुखे स्थातुं तस्य शत्रुनिषूदनाः॥
en: Thus thwarted in that battle by the king of the Madras, O Bharata, those slayers of foes could not stand in front of Shalya.

sa: निवेशनं च कुप्यं व क्षेत्रं भार्या सुहज्जनः। एतान्युपहितान्याहुः सर्वत्र लभते पुमान्॥
en: Houses, precious metals, land, wife, ar.J friends,-these are spoken by the learned as the secondary sources of good. A man may obtain them everywhere.

sa: श्रोतुमिच्छामि भगवंस्त्वत्तः सर्वं यथातथम्। भवान् हि सर्वविद् विद्वान् लोके वेद कृताकृतम्।।४४।
en: I wish to hear everything from you, O Rishi. You know everything of this world, as also of both the past and the future.

sa: हयं वा दन्तिनं वापि रथं वा नृपसत्तम। अभिरोहन्त्यनादृत्य हर्षुले पार्थिवे मृदौ॥
en: If the king becomes mild and cuts jokes, his servants, disobeying him, ride on horses and elephants and cars as good as the king's.

sa: प्रवृद्धानां च वृक्षाणां शाखां प्रच्छेदयेत् तथा। चैत्यानां सर्वथा त्याज्यमपि पत्रस्य पातनम्॥
en: He should cause the branches of all large threes to be cut off, but he should not touch the very leaves of Chaitya ones.

sa: चरुद्वयं गृहीत्वा च राजन् सत्यवती तदा। भर्तुर्वाक्यं तदाव्यग्रा मात्रे हृष्टा न्यवेदयत्॥
en: O king, thereupon taking the two portions of the sanctified food, Satyavati cheerfully and quickly, represented the words of her husband to her inother.

sa: धनं वा पुरुषो राजन् पुरुषं वा पुनर्धनम्। अवश्यं प्रजहात्येव तद् विद्वान् कोऽनुसंज्वरेत्॥ अन्येषामपि नश्यन्ति सुहृदश्च धनानि च।
en: Sometimes man renounces wealth, and sometimes wealth renounces man. What man endued with knowledge is there who would grieve at the loss of wealth? There are many other persons in the world who lose wealth and friends.

sa: यत् कर्म वै निग्रहे शात्रवाणां योगश्चाम्यः पालने मानवानाम्। कृत्वा कर्म प्राप्य कीर्तिं स युद्धाद् वाजिग्रीवो मोदते स्वर्गलोके॥
en: Having done all for restraining his foes and adopted all those foremost of means by which men may be protected, Hayagriva won great fame from the battles he fought and is now enjoying great bliss in heaven.

sa: महादण्डश्च तस्य स्याद् यस्याग्निवै दिवा भवेत्। प्रघोषयेदथैवं च रक्षणार्थं पुरस्य च॥
en: For the better protection of the city, it should be announced that a person, lighting fires in the day time, will be sufficiently punished.

sa: तस्माद् दानेन तपसा कर्मणा च फलं शुभम्। वर्धयेदशुभं कृत्वा यथा स्यादतिरेकवान्॥
en: By knowledge, by penances, and by pious acts, therefore, one multiplies his happiness. One, therefore, may likewise increase his misery by committing sinful acts.

sa: हन्तैकं भवतामेकः शक्यं मां योऽभिमन्यते॥ पदातिर्गदया संख्ये स युध्यतु मया सह।
en: Let any of you, who thinks that he is a match for me, come forward and fight with me on foot, arined with mace.
